অধ্যক্ষ মোহাম্মদ জহিরুল ইসলাম ত্রয়োদশ জ:
Principal Mohammad Zahirul Islam is the member of parliament for Chattogram-16 (Banshkhali) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami, and took the oath as a member of parliament on 17 February 2026.

Zahirul Islam was born on 12 March 1976 in Shekherkhil union, Banshkhali upazila, Chattogram district. He is the son of Maulana Md. Ishaq and Mosammat Johora Begum.

He obtained a bachelor's (honours) degree in law. He began his career in 1998 as a lecturer at Hamedia Rahima Fazil Madrasa in Banshkhali. In 2001 he was appointed principal of the same madrasa.

At the age of only 24 he was elected chairman of the Shekherkhil union parishad, and he held the post for two terms. In the upazila parishad election held on 23 March 2014 he was elected chairman of the Banshkhali upazila parishad. In 2018 he gave up the post of upazila chairman to take part in the parliamentary election.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected member of parliament for Chattogram-16 as the Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami candidate, winning 93,167 votes.
অ্যাডভোকেট আবুল কালাম নারায়ণগঞ্জ-৫ (সদর:
Advocate Abul Kalam is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Narayanganj-5 (Sadar and Bandar). This veteran BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party) leader has become an MP for the fourth time.

He was born on 11 March 1951 in Narayanganj District. His father, Haji Jalal Uddin Ahmed, was a founding member of the BNP and a member of parliament. His mother is Rahemunnesa Begum. He is a lawyer by profession and was enrolled as a lawyer in 1987.

Abul Kalam has served as president of the Narayanganj Metropolitan BNP and as a member of the BNP's central executive committee. He was elected MP from Narayanganj-5 in the parliamentary elections of 1991, February 1996 and 2001.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was again elected MP for Narayanganj-5 with 114,799 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
অ্যাডভোকেট নূরুল ইসলাম সুনামগঞ্জ-৪ (সুনা:
Advocate Nurul Islam is a Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Sunamganj-4 (Sunamganj Sadar and Bishwamvarpur). Known as Nurul Islam Nurul, this lawyer and politician is representing the seat in Parliament for the first time, in the 13th Parliament.

Nurul Islam was born on 9 October 1976 in Sunamganj Sadar Upazila, Sunamganj District. His father is Mahtab Ali and his mother Nurjahan Begum. He is a lawyer by profession.

In the 2026 election, as the candidate of the BNP and its alliance, he announced an 11-point election manifesto. It contained pledges on social security, protection of the haors, agriculture, employment, education, healthcare and women's empowerment. He said he wanted to be an MP of the people, not of power.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for the first time, with 98,092 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
আজহারুল ইসলাম মান্নান নারায়ণগঞ্জ-৩ (সোন:
Azharul Islam Mannan is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Narayanganj-3 (Sonargaon and Siddhirganj). This is his first term in Parliament, as the nominee of the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Religious Affairs.

He was born on 25 December 1965 in Sonargaon Upazila, Narayanganj District. His father is Lal Mia Bepari and his mother Ayesha Khatun. He is a businessman by profession.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Narayanganj-3 with 155,400 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. After his victory he said he dedicated it to the welfare of the people.
আতিকুল আলম ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে কুমিল্ল:
Atikul Alam is the independent member of parliament for Cumilla-7 (Chandina upazila) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time. Locally he is known as Atikul Alam Shawon.

Atikul Alam was born in Chandina, Cumilla. He is the son of Md. Khorshed Alam and Jebun Nahar. After completing his primary education at Chandina Adarsha Government Primary School, he passed the SSC in 2006 from Chandina Government Model Pilot School and the HSC from Coda College in Dhanmondi, Dhaka. He later completed an LLB (Honours) at Bhuiyan Academy.

In politics he has served as president of Chandina upazila BNP. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected member of parliament for Cumilla-7 as an independent candidate, winning 91,690 votes with the pitcher symbol. He is the father of a son and a daughter.
আনিছুর রহমান মাদারীপুর-৩ আসন থেকে নির্বা:
Anisur Rahaman is a Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Madaripur-3. Known as Anisur Rahman Talukder Khokon, this politician is representing the seat in Parliament for the first time, in the 13th Parliament.

He was born on 6 May 1976. His father is Haji Esahak Uddin Talukder and his mother Golbahar Begum. He is a businessman by profession.

In party politics he holds the post responsible for mass education affairs in the central BNP. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP with 96,188 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
আন্না মিন্‌জ ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে সংরক্:
Anna Minj is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-19 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament for the first time on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament she is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Women and Children Affairs.

Anna Minj was born on 31 October 1961. She is the daughter of the late Paulus Minj and the late Serafina Kujur. She lives in Jonail village, Baraigram upazila, Natore district.

A leader of the Oraon community, she has been working for the development of Christians and people of small ethnic groups. Anna Minj is one of the 36 people the BNP nominated for the reserved women's seats in the 13th Parliament. She became the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-19 through the votes of the members of parliament. She is the country's first member of parliament from the Oraon community.

Her husband, Advocate John Gomes, is a lawyer by profession and assistant religious affairs secretary of the BNP central committee.
আবদুল আউয়াল মিন্টু পরিবেশ, বন ও জলবায়ু:
Abdul Awal Mintoo is the Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change and the member of parliament for Feni-3. He took office as minister on 17 February 2026. A former president of the FBCCI, the country's apex business organisation, this industrial entrepreneur is a senior BNP leader; he has also served as the party's vice-chairman.

He was born on 22 February 1949 in Aliarpur village, Feni; his father is Alhaj Shafiullah. He passed the SSC from Feni Government Pilot High School in 1964 and the HSC from Cumilla Victoria College in 1966. After a diploma in nautical science in 1968 from what was then the Pakistan Marine Academy (now the Mercantile Marine Academy), he obtained a bachelor's degree in marine transportation and a master's degree in transportation management from the State University of New York Maritime College in the United States.

In 2003 he was elected president of the Federation of Bangladesh Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FBCCI). He was a director of National Bank and of a large private insurance company, and he is involved in shipping, textiles, cement and agro-based industries, particularly vegetable seed production and research. He was president of the Bangladesh Employers' Federation (1997–99), chairman of the Bangladesh Ocean Going Ship Owners' Association (1988–2000) and chairman of the Bangladesh-India Chamber of Commerce. He has also served on the governing boards of the Dhaka Stock Exchange, Bangladesh Open University and the Bangladesh Institute of Management. He has founded several educational institutions in his home area.

In the election of 12 February 2026 he was elected a member of parliament for the first time, winning 157,425 votes in Feni-3. His wife, Nasreen Fatema Awal, is the founding president of the Women Entrepreneurs Association of Bangladesh; they have three sons, Tabith, Tafsir and Tajwar Awal.
আবদুল ওয়াদুদ ভূঁঞা ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদ:
Abdul Wadud Bhuiyan is the member of parliament for the hill district seat of Khagrachhari in the 13th Parliament. This leader of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has been elected member of parliament from this seat for the third time. He is assistant employment affairs secretary of the BNP central executive committee and president of the Khagrachhari district BNP.

Wadud Bhuiyan was born on 5 January 1965 in Ramgarh, Khagrachhari. His father, Alhaj Saleh Ahammad Bhuiyan, was a businessman and social worker; his mother is Bia Saleh. He received his first lessons from his mother; he also became proficient in the local Chakma language. After studying at Ramgarh Government Primary School, he obtained a master's degree (MSS) in sociology from the University of Chittagong in 1986. He is a politician and businessman by profession.

As a student he was convener of the University of Chittagong unit of the Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal from 1987 to 1989 and president of the Ramgarh unit of the Chhatra Dal from 1980 to 1990. In 1989 he was elected a member of the Khagrachhari Hill District Council. In February 1996 and in 2001 he was elected member of parliament for the Khagrachhari seat as the BNP candidate. In 2001 he became a member of the parliamentary standing committee on the Ministry of Chittagong Hill Tracts Affairs, and from 2002 to 2006 he served as chairman of the Chittagong Hill Tracts Development Board.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected member of parliament for the Khagrachhari seat as the BNP candidate, winning 148,212 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
আবদুল হান্নান মাসউদ ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদ:
Abdul Hannan Masud is the member of parliament for Noakhali-6 (Hatiya) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time, from the National Citizen Party (NCP). He is a senior joint chief coordinator of the NCP and the youngest male member of Parliament.

Masud was born on 1 January 2000 in Burirchar union, Hatiya upazila, Noakhali district. His father, Amirul Islam Mohammad Abdul Malek, is a retired madrasa teacher, and his mother is Ayesha Khatun Bilkis. He is studying for an undergraduate (honours) degree at the University of Dhaka.

He first gained national prominence during the 2024 quota reform movement. He was one of the coordinators of Students Against Discrimination, which led the movement, and later joined the leadership of the National Citizen Party.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, contesting Noakhali-6 on the National Citizen Party's nomination as the candidate of the 11-party electoral alliance, he was elected a member of parliament with 91,899 votes. In 2025 he married Shamoli Sultana Jedni, a former leader of Jatiya Chhatra Shakti.
আব্দুল্লাহ আল আমিন নারায়ণগঞ্জ-৪ আসন থেক:
Abdullah Al Amin is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Narayanganj-4. This is his first term in Parliament, as the nominee of the National Citizen Party (NCP). He is head of the NCP's discipline department.

He was born on 4 September 1995 in Narayanganj and grew up there. His father is Md. Zakir Hossain and his mother Ayesha Khatun. After completing his studies at local schools and colleges, he obtained LLB (Hons) and LLM degrees from the Department of Law at the University of Dhaka. By profession he is a High Court lawyer.

As a student he was active in the quota reform movement and the road safety movement, and he was out on the streets in the July 2024 mass uprising. He later joined the National Citizen Party and was given the post of chief coordinator of the NCP's Narayanganj District unit.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Narayanganj-4 with 106,171 votes as the candidate of an 11-party electoral alliance. He is a member of the Narayanganj District Law and Order Committee and of the Red Crescent Society.
আমির খসরু মাহমুদ চৌধুরী অর্থ ও পরিকল্পনা:
Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury is the Minister of Finance and Planning and the member of parliament for Chattogram-11. He took charge of the two ministries on 17 February 2026. He came into politics with long experience as a businessman and an organiser of the capital market; he is a member of the standing committee, the BNP's highest policymaking forum.

He was born in North Kattali, Pahartali, Chattogram. His father, Mahmudunnabi Chowdhury, was elected a member of the East Pakistan Legislative Assembly for the United Front in 1954 and was minister of mass communication, and later of relief and rehabilitation, in the provincial government; his mother is Meherunnesa Begum Chowdhury. After obtaining a bachelor's degree from Chittagong College in 1969, he went on to higher studies in accounting in London.

After completing his studies he joined the family business. He was the founder and chairman of the Chittagong Stock Exchange, president of the Chittagong Chamber of Commerce and Industry and the first president of the South Asian Federation of Exchanges. He has also served as honorary consul of South Korea in Chattogram, acting chairman of Sonali Bank and a member of the advisory committee of the National Board of Revenue.

He first entered Parliament in 1991 by winning the by-election held after Khaleda Zia gave up the Chattogram-8 seat; he won the same seat in both elections of 1996 and again in 2001. He was Minister of Commerce from 10 October 2001 to 25 March 2004. He has also served as president of the Chattogram metropolitan BNP. Elected from Chattogram-11 in the election to the 13th Parliament, he joined Tarique Rahman's cabinet. He is married to Tahera Alam; they have one son and one daughter.
আরিফুল হক চৌধুরী শ্রম ও কর্মসংস্থান এবং:
Ariful Haque Choudhury is the Minister for Labour and Employment and for Expatriates' Welfare and Overseas Employment, and the member of parliament for Sylhet-4. He took charge of the two ministries on 17 February 2026. He was mayor of Sylhet City Corporation for two terms and is a member of the BNP chairperson's advisory council.

He was born on 23 November 1959 at Kumarpara in Sylhet; he is the son of Md. Shafiqul Haque Choudhury and Amina Khatun.

His political career began as a member of Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal. He was president of Sylhet Metropolitan BNP and general secretary of the district BNP, and has also served as a member of the party's central committee. In 2003 he was elected a councillor of Sylhet City Corporation and became chairman of its urban development and planning committee; he was later mayor of the city for two terms.

Elected a member of parliament for the first time from Sylhet-4 in the 2026 election to the 13th Parliament, he was given charge of the two ministries for expatriates working abroad and for the country's workers.
আলমগীর মুহাম্মদ মাহফুজ উল্লাহ ফরিদ ত্রয়:
Alamgir Mohammed Mahfuz Ullah Farid is the member of parliament for Cox's Bazar-2 (Kutubdia and Moheshkhali upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. This leader of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has been elected member of parliament from this seat for the third time. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Water Resources.

Mahfuz Ullah Farid was born on 1 October 1957 in Moheshkhali upazila, Cox's Bazar district. He is the son of Aktar Kamal and Surat Jamal Begum. In a family of eight brothers and sisters, he is the third of the brothers. His elder brother, the late Sirajul Haque, was a union parishad chairman, and his younger brother, Mohammad Shahidullah, was chairman of the Bara Moheshkhali union parishad.

He is a lawyer by profession and a member of the Cox's Bazar Bar Association. In 1996 he was first elected member of parliament for Cox's Bazar-2 as the BNP candidate, and in 2001 he was re-elected from the same seat. In Parliament he served on the Committee on Public Undertakings. He is a member of the BNP national executive committee.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was again elected member of parliament for Cox's Bazar-2 as the BNP candidate, winning 125,543 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
আলহাজ্ব জসীম উদ্দীন আহমেদ ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয:
Alhajj Jashim Uddin Ahammed is the member of parliament for Chattogram-14 (Chandanaish upazila and six unions of Satkania upazila) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Civil Aviation and Tourism.

Jashim Uddin Ahammed was born on 10 June 1977 in Chandanaish. He is the son of Alhaj Mofzal Ahmad and Haji Nur Begum. He is a businessman by profession. Before becoming a member of parliament he served as chairman of the Chandanaish upazila parishad.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected member of parliament for Chattogram-14 as the BNP's nominated candidate, winning 76,493 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
আলহাজ্ব মোঃ জি কে গউছ হবিগঞ্জ-৩ আসন থেকে:
Alhaj Md. G.K. Gouse is the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Habiganj-3 and a Whip in the 13th Parliament. This is his first term in Parliament. He is also chair of the standing committee on the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change.

G.K. Gouse was born on 20 April 1968 in Shayestanagar village, Habiganj Sadar upazila. His father was the late Alhaj Golam Murtuza and his mother the late Alhaj Monjila Begum. By profession he is a businessman.

In local government he has served as mayor of Habiganj municipality. In party politics he is BNP's central organising secretary (Sylhet division). In August 2025 he was elected unopposed as president of Habiganj district BNP.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament for the first time, winning 142,348 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. He was later made a Whip of Parliament. He is married to Farhana Gouse Happy and is the father of two sons.
আলী নেওয়াজ মাহমুদ খৈয়ম সংস্কৃতি বিষয়ক:
Ali Newaz Mahmood Khyom is State Minister for Cultural Affairs and MP for Rajbari-1 (Sadar-Goalanda). He took office on 17 February 2026. A member of the BNP's central executive committee, Khyom is president of the Rajbari District BNP.

He was born on 25 May 1957; his father is Dr. A. K. M. A. Wahid.

He was first elected MP from Rajbari-1 as the BNP candidate in the 2001 parliamentary election. He was defeated in the same seat in the 2008 and 2018 elections. Winning again in the 13th parliamentary election of 2026, he entered Parliament for the second time and became State Minister for Cultural Affairs.
এ এম মাহবুব উদ্দিন ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
A M Mahbub Uddin Khokon is the member of parliament for Noakhali-1 (Chatkhil upazila and part of Sonaimuri upazila) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the second time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). He is a well-known lawyer, known as Mahbub Uddin Khokon. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, the standing committee on public accounts and the committee on private members' bills and resolutions.

Mahbub Uddin Khokon was born on 12 January 1956 at Sonapur, Sonaimuri upazila, Noakhali district. He is the son of Momtaz Uddin Ahmed and Rowshan Ara Begum. He is the eldest of nine siblings. After passing the SSC from Gopalpur High School, Noakhali, and the HSC from Dhaka Government College, he obtained an LLB degree from the University of Dhaka. In 1992 he completed an LLB (Honours) in Wales, United Kingdom, and in 1993 he was called to the bar at Lincoln's Inn.

He has practised law since 1994. He is the founder and head of the Dhaka-based law firm Mahbub & Company. He has also served as a lawyer for BNP chairperson Khaleda Zia. In March 2024 he was elected president of the Bangladesh Supreme Court Bar Association.

In the 9th parliamentary election in 2008 he was elected a member of parliament for the first time, from Noakhali-1 as the BNP candidate. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament for the second time, from the same seat, winning 126,833 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. He is the father of a daughter and a son; his son is also a barrister.
এ, কে, এম, ফজলুল হক মিলন গাজীপুর-৫ (কালী:
A. K. M. Fazlul Haque Milan is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Gazipur-5 (Kaliganj). This BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party) leader has become an MP for the third time. In September 2026 he was nominated chair of the Parliamentary Standing Committee on the Ministry of Expatriates' Welfare and Overseas Employment. He is also a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Water Resources and the Standing Committee on Public Accounts.

He was born in 1963. His father is Ekamuddin and his mother Sahida Khatun.

Rising through student politics, Fazlul Haque Milan served as central publicity secretary and later central president of Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal. He was an active organiser in the anti-autocracy movement of 1990. He later served as central general secretary of the Swechchhasebak Dal, general secretary and president of the Gazipur District BNP, a member of the BNP's National Executive Committee and central organising secretary (Dhaka Division).

He had previously been elected MP twice from what was then Gazipur-3 (now Gazipur-5, Kaliganj), one of these being the 2001 parliamentary election.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Gazipur-5 with 133,869 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
এ. বি. এম আশরাফ উদ্দিন (নিজান) ত্রয়োদশ:
A.B.M. Ashraf Uddin (Nizan) is the member of parliament for Laxmipur-4 (Ramgati and Kamalnagar upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. He represents this seat for the third time for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). Since 12 September 2026 he has served as a Whip in Parliament. He is also a member of the Standing Committee on Public Accounts, the Library Committee and the Special Committee.

Freedom fighter Ashraf Uddin Nizan is a native of Ramgati in Lakshmipur. He is the son of Abdul Hadi Mia and Mosammat Zakia Khatun. He obtained a master's degree from the University of Chittagong. He is a businessman by profession.

He was elected member of parliament for Laxmipur-4 as the BNP candidate in the elections to the 8th and 9th Parliaments in 2001 and 2008. In Parliament he served as chair of the parliamentary standing committee on the Ministry of Fisheries and Livestock. Within the party he is industry and commerce affairs secretary of the BNP central executive committee.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was again elected member of parliament for Laxmipur-4, winning 115,199 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
এম মঞ্জুরুল করিম রনি গাজীপুর-২ (গাজীপুর:
M Manjurul Karim Roni is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Gazipur-2 (Gazipur Sadar and Tongi). This is his first term in Parliament, as the nominee of the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). He is general secretary of the Gazipur Metropolitan BNP.

Manjurul Karim was born on 12 February 1984 into a political family in Gazipur. His late father, Professor M. A. Mannan, was the first elected mayor of Gazipur City Corporation and a former State Minister for Religious Affairs and for Science and Technology. His mother is Sajeda Mannan. He entered politics carrying on his father's political legacy and ideal of public service.

The 13th parliamentary election, held on 12 February 2026, was his first parliamentary election. In it he was elected MP for Gazipur-2 with 188,606 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
এম, এ, হান্নান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে ব্র:
M. A. Hannan is the member of parliament for Brahmanbaria-1 (Nasirnagar upazila) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), and is BNP's first member of parliament from this seat. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Fisheries and Livestock. He is also president of Nasirnagar upazila BNP.

Hannan was born on 1 January 1973 in Nasirnagar upazila, Brahmanbaria district. He is the son of Md. Abdul Hekim and Sulema Khatun. He comes from a family of martyrs. His brother Abdul Kadir is a freedom fighter and the commander of the Nasirnagar upazila Muktijoddha Sangsad (freedom fighters' council). By profession he is a businessman.

A politician who rose from the grassroots, he has served as chairman of a union parishad. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament, winning 68,092 votes in Brahmanbaria-1 with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
এমরান আহমদ চৌধুরী সিলেট-৬ আসন থেকে নির্ব:
Emran Ahmed Chowdhury is the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Sylhet-6. A lawyer and politician, he is serving in Parliament for the first time, as a member of the 13th Parliament. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs.

He was born on 1 November 1967 in Kotoyalpur village, Hetimganj, Lakshmipasha union, Golapganj upazila, Sylhet district. He is the son of Ziaur Rahman Chowdhury and Afia Khatun Chowdhury.

After passing the SSC from Atharia High School and the HSC from Murari Chand College, Sylhet, he obtained BSc and MSc degrees from the Department of Physics at the University of Chittagong. He later obtained an MA from the Department of Bangla at the University of Dhaka and an LLM from Sylhet International University. He completed a diploma in leadership, management, politics and international risk at the University of South Wales in the United Kingdom, and the Graduate Diploma in Law course at Nottingham Trent University.

On 10 January 2019 he joined the Sylhet District Bar Association as a lawyer. He is the editor and publisher of the Sylhet-based daily Sachitra Sylhet.

As a student he was general secretary of Sylhet district Chhatra Dal. He is currently general secretary of Sylhet district BNP. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament for the first time, winning 108,612 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. He is married to Syeda Nurunnahar and is the father of two daughters.
এরশাদ উল্লাহ ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে চট্টগ:
Ershad Ullah is the member of parliament for Chattogram-8 (part of Boalkhali upazila and wards 3 to 7 of Chattogram City Corporation) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). He is convener of the Chattogram metropolitan BNP. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Land.

Ershad Ullah was born in Chattogram on 21 March 1954. He is the son of Sharafat Ullah and Anwara Begum. He is a businessman by profession.

He has long been involved in BNP politics in Chattogram. In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected member of parliament as the BNP's nominated candidate for Chattogram-8, winning 152,969 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
এস, এম, জাহাঙ্গীর হোসেন ঢাকা-১৮ আসন থেকে:
S. M. Jahangir Hossain is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Dhaka-18. This is his first term in Parliament, as the nominee of the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). He is a joint convener of the convening committee of the BNP's Dhaka Metropolitan North unit and, in Parliament, a member of the House Committee.

Jahangir Hossain was born in Dhaka on 1 January 1973. His father is A. K. M. Nuruzzaman and his mother Khairun Nesa. After his higher secondary education he enrolled at Tejgaon College.

His political career began in 1988 as a member of Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal. He took part in the anti-autocracy movement of 1990 and that year was general secretary of the Chhatra Dal's college unit. The following year he was elected vice-president of the Tejgaon College students' union. In 1994 he became social welfare secretary of the Chhatra Dal, and in 2001 president of the Chhatra Dal's Dhaka Metropolitan North unit. He later joined the Jubo Dal and served as general secretary of the Dhaka Metropolitan North Jubo Dal in 2010, and as the Jubo Dal's central publicity secretary and central vice-president.

He was the BNP candidate for Dhaka-18 in the 2018 parliamentary election and in the 2020 by-election. During the 2024 quota reform movement he stood by the students and was involved in the movement in the Uttara area.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Dhaka-18 with 144,715 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. His wife is Razia Sultana; the couple have two daughters.
এস, এম, জিলানী গোপালগঞ্জ-৩ (টুঙ্গিপাড়া:
S. M. Zilany is a Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Gopalganj-3 (Tungipara and Kotalipara). This is his first term, in the 13th Parliament.

S. M. Zilany was born on 2 June 1969 in Tungipara Upazila, Gopalganj District. His father is Sheikh Abdur Rashid and his mother Mst. Nurun Nahar.

In party politics he is president of Jatiyatabadi Swechchhasebak Dal, an associate organisation of the BNP. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for the first time, with 60,991 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. In this election the sheaf of paddy candidates won all three seats in Gopalganj District.
এস, এম, ফয়সল ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে হবিগ:
S.M. Faisal is the member of parliament for Habiganj-4 (Chunarughat and Madhabpur upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. Elected from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), the politician has come to Parliament for the second time. His full name is Syed Mohammad Faisal, but he is better known as S.M. Faisal.

Faisal was born on 1 January 1942 in Madhabpur upazila, Habiganj district. His father, Syed Sayeed Uddin Ahmad, was a member of the provincial assembly (MPA), and his mother is Begum Hamida Banu. He obtained MA and LLB degrees from the University of Dhaka. By profession he is an industrialist. He serves as chairman of Saiham Cotton Mills Limited and managing director of Saiham Textile Mills Limited, both of the Saiham Group.

In politics, Faisal has long been involved with BNP in Habiganj. He has served as president of Habiganj district BNP. In the 6th parliamentary election held on 15 February 1996, he was elected a member of parliament for the first time, from the Habiganj-4 seat. In the 2018 election, on a party decision, he gave up the seat to an alliance partner's candidate.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament for the second time, winning 188,072 votes in Habiganj-4 with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
কলিম উদ্দিন আহমেদ সুনামগঞ্জ-৫ আসন থেকে ন:
Kalim Uddin Ahmed is a Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Sunamganj-5. Known as Kalim Uddin Ahmed Milon, this experienced politician is representing his seat in Parliament for the fourth time. In the 13th Parliament he serves as chair of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology.

Kalim Uddin Ahmed was born in 1958 in Bagbari, Chhatak Upazila, Sunamganj District. His father is Habib Ulla and his mother Hasna Begum.

He has been active in politics since his student days. He was initially involved in the politics of the Jatiya Samajtantrik Dal (JSD). He was first elected MP from Sunamganj-5 as the JSD candidate in the election to the 4th Parliament in 1988. He was elected for the second time, as an independent candidate, in the election to the 6th Parliament on 15 February 1996.

In 1996 he joined the BNP and served as organising secretary, general secretary and convener of the Sunamganj District BNP. He was elected MP for the third time, on the BNP's nomination, in the election to the 8th Parliament in 2001. In 2017 he was elected president of the Sunamganj District BNP. He has also served as an assistant organising secretary of the central BNP.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for the fourth time, with 151,915 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
কাজী শাহ মোফাজ্জাল হোসাইন কায়কোবাদ ধর্ম:
Kazi Shah Mofazzal Houssain Kaikobad is the Minister for Religious Affairs and the member of parliament for Cumilla-3 (Muradnagar). He was appointed Minister for Religious Affairs on 17 February 2026. He has been elected a member of parliament from this seat six times, and has previously served twice as State Minister for Religious Affairs.

He was born on 20 February 1956 in Muradnagar, Cumilla; his father is Kazi Noman Ahmed.

He first became a member of parliament in the 3rd parliamentary election in 1986, on a Jatiya Party nomination, and for the second time in 1988. He was State Minister for Religious Affairs from 2 May to 6 December 1990. He won again for the Jatiya Party in the June 1996 election. He later joined BNP, became a member of parliament on the party's nomination in 2001, and again served as State Minister for Religious Affairs from 3 August 2002 to 1 July 2003. He was elected in 2008 as well. In 2016 he became a vice-chairman of BNP.

In 2018 he was sentenced to life imprisonment in the case over the grenade attack of 21 August 2004; he had been abroad since 2014. On 1 December 2024 the High Court acquitted him and all the other accused in the case. Having returned home after the July mass uprising, he won the Cumilla-3 seat for the sixth time in the 2026 election.
কামরুজ্জামান কামরুল সুনামগঞ্জ-১ (তাহিরপু:
Kamruzzaman Kamrul is a Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Sunamganj-1 (Tahirpur, Jamalganj, Madhyanagar and Dharmapasha). This is his first term, in the 13th Parliament.

Kamruzzaman Kamrul was born on 7 January 1978 in Tahirpur Upazila, Sunamganj District. His father is Niam Uddin and his mother Jahanara Begum. He is a businessman by profession.

He has experience in local politics and as an elected representative. He is a former chairman of the Tahirpur Upazila Parishad and a former organising secretary of the Sunamganj District BNP. On the instructions of the party's central leadership he became the BNP candidate for Sunamganj-1.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for the first time, with 161,774 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
খন্দকার আবদুল মুক্তাদীর শিল্প, বাণিজ্য এ:
Khandakar Abdul Muktadir is Minister for Industries, for Commerce and for Textiles and Jute, and MP for Sylhet-1. He took charge of these three ministries on 17 February 2026. An industrialist and former president of the Sylhet Chamber of Commerce and Industry, Muktadir has been an adviser to the BNP chairperson since 2016.

He was born on 25 September 1969 in Ahmadpur village, Tetli Union, Dakshin Surma Upazila, Sylhet. His father, Khandakar Abdul Malik, was a BNP politician and MP for what were then the Sylhet-8 and Sylhet-1 seats. He passed his SSC from Sylhet Cadet College and his HSC from Dhaka City College, then obtained an MSS in political science from the National University and an MBA in business administration from North South University.

He entered active politics by joining the BNP in 2011. He was the party's candidate for Sylhet-1 in the 2018 election. Elected MP for the first time from the same seat in the 13th parliamentary election of 2026, he was given charge of the country's industry and commerce sectors in the cabinet.

His wife is Zakia Yasmin; they have a son and a daughter.
খায়রুল কবির খোকন নরসিংদী-১ আসন থেকে নির:
Khairul Kabir Khokon is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Narsingdi-1. This BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party) leader has become an MP for the second time. He is a joint secretary general of the BNP and president of the Narsingdi District BNP.

Khairul Kabir Khokon was born in Narsingdi District. His father is Md. Zahirul Haque and his mother Zahura Begum. He is a businessman by profession.

As a student he was the elected general secretary (GS) of the Dhaka University Central Students' Union (DUCSU). He has long served as president of the Narsingdi District BNP. When the seat fell vacant on the death of MP Shamsuddin Ahmed Ishaq in 2005, he was elected MP from Narsingdi-1 for the first time in the by-election. In 2026 the Speaker of Parliament nominated him a member of the Senate of the University of Dhaka.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Narsingdi-1 with 161,405 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. His wife, Shirin Sultana, is self-reliance affairs secretary of the BNP's central committee.
গিয়াস উদ্দিন কাদের চৌধুরী ত্রয়োদশ জাতী:
Gias Uddin Quader Chowdhury is the member of parliament for Chattogram-6 (Raozan) in the 13th Parliament. This experienced politician of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has been elected member of parliament for the third time.

Gias Uddin Quader Chowdhury was born on 29 April 1953. He is the son of A.K.M. Fazlul Quader Chowdhury and Selima Quader Chowdhury. Alongside politics he is involved in business; he was a director of the family-owned QC Container Line Limited, QC Shipping Limited and Dhaka Dyeing.

He was first elected member of parliament for Chattogram-7 as the Jatiya Party candidate in the election to the 3rd Parliament in 1986. He later joined the BNP and was elected BNP member of parliament for Chattogram-6 in the election to the 7th Parliament in 1996. Within the party he has served as a vice-chairman of the BNP and as president of the Chattogram North district BNP.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected member of parliament for Chattogram-6 as the BNP candidate, winning 112,237 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
জয়নাল আবদিন ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে ফেনী-:
Joynal Abdin is the member of parliament for Feni-2 (Feni Sadar upazila) in the 13th Parliament. Elected from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), this freedom fighter has come to Parliament for the fourth time. In political circles he is known as "VP Joynal". In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Land.

Joynal Abdin was born in Faleshwar village, Feni. His father, Chan Mia, was an official of the Assam Bengal Railway, and his mother is Ojibennesa. He is the youngest of five siblings. After passing the SSC from Feni Government Pilot High School and the HSC and BA from Feni Government College, he obtained an MA in political science from the University of Chittagong in 1976. In his working life, alongside business, he taught in the political science department of Sonaimuri College, Noakhali, in 1977.

He became active in politics as a student. Elected VP (vice-president) of the Feni College students' union in 1970, he became known as "VP Joynal". In 1971 he was elected president of the all-party Swadhin Bangla Chhatra Sangram Parishad (independent Bangla students' action council), and on 2 March he raised the flag of Bangladesh at Feni Government College. During the Liberation War he received military training at Dehradun in India and was appointed a district zonal commander of the BLF (Bangladesh Liberation Force).

When JASAD (Jatiya Samajtantrik Dal) was formed in 1972, he became a member of its central committee and the founding general secretary of its Feni district unit. In the 4th parliamentary election in 1988 he was elected a member of parliament for the first time, from Feni-2 for JASAD. He later joined BNP, served as general secretary of Feni district BNP from 1996 to 2009, and was again elected a member of parliament from the same seat in 2001 and 2008. In Parliament he was a member of the standing committees on the Ministries of Finance, Textiles, Works and Liberation War Affairs. He is an adviser to the BNP chairperson.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament for the fourth time, winning 131,210 votes in Feni-2 with the sheaf of paddy symbol. He is married to Shahana Akter, and the couple have two sons and two daughters.
জয়নুল আবদিন ফারুক ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Zainul Abdin Farroque is the member of parliament for Noakhali-2 (Senbagh upazila and four unions of Sonaimuri upazila) in the 13th Parliament. Elected from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), this freedom fighter has come to Parliament for the sixth time. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on privileges.

Zainul Abdin Farroque was born on 10 December 1949 in Noakhali district. He is the son of Abdul Haque and Hafeza Khatun. In 1971 he took part in the Liberation War.

Long active in BNP politics, Farroque was elected a member of parliament from Noakhali in the 5th parliamentary election in 1991, the 6th in February 1996, the 7th in June 1996, the 8th in 2001 and the 9th in 2008. In the 9th Parliament, in 2009, he was made Chief Whip of the opposition. He has also served as an adviser to BNP chairperson Khaleda Zia.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament for the sixth time, winning 83,982 votes in Noakhali-2 with the sheaf of paddy symbol. His late wife, Kaniz Fatema, was also involved in BNP politics. The couple have a daughter.
জাকারিয়া তাহের সুমন গৃহায়ন ও গণপূর্ত ম:
Zakaria Taher Sumon is the Minister for Housing and Public Works and the member of parliament for Cumilla-8 (Barura). He took office as minister on 17 February 2026. A businessman, Sumon was previously the member of parliament for Cumilla-7.

He was born in Barura, Cumilla. His father, A. K. M. Abu Taher, was an industrialist, the member of parliament for Cumilla-7, and the founder and chairman of National Bank Limited, the country's first private bank.

When his father's death on 23 September 2004 led to a by-election in Cumilla-7, he won it as the BNP candidate in December that year and came to Parliament for the first time. Elected from Cumilla-8 in the 2026 election to the 13th Parliament, he became a member of parliament for the second time and joined Tarique Rahman's Cabinet.
জীবা আমিনা খান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে সংর:
Zeeba Amina Khan is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-12 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament for the first time on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). She is a member of the BNP national executive committee and a vice-president of the Jatiyatabadi Mohila Dal. In Parliament she is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Liberation War Affairs.

Zeeba Amina Khan was born on 21 June 1962 in Jhalakathi Sadar upazila. She is the daughter of Akhtar Uddin Ahmed and Atia Ahmed. She is a businesswoman by profession.

She is active in the politics of Jhalakathi district. In the election to the 11th Parliament in 2018 she contested Jhalakathi-2 (Sadar and Nalchity) on the BNP's nomination with the sheaf of paddy symbol. In April 2026 the BNP nominated her for a reserved women's seat. She became the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-12 through the votes of the members of parliament.
জোনায়েদ আব্দুর রহিম সাকি পরিকল্পনা প্রত:
Zonayed Abdur Rahim Saki is the State Minister for Planning and the member of parliament for Brahmanbaria-6. He has held this post since 4 March 2026. A founding leader and the chief coordinator of Ganosamhati Andolan, Saki has been involved for more than three decades in movements of students and workers, for the protection of national resources, and for democracy and state reform.

He was born on 9 December 1973 in Charlahonia village, Bancharampur upazila, Brahmanbaria; he is the son of Md. Fazlur Rahman and Masuda Khanam. In 1991 he was admitted to the Department of Statistics at the University of Dhaka.

He entered politics through the 1990 mass movement against autocracy and joined the Bangladesh Chhatra Federation. Elected the organisation's central president in 1998, he led various student movements, including those at the University of Dhaka against increases in tuition fees (1998) and against sexual harassment (1999). He left student politics in 2000.

On 29 August 2002 he led the founding of Ganosamhati Andolan together with activists from labour and social movements, and in 2016 he formally became the party's chief coordinator. He had a leading role in the National Committee to Protect Oil, Gas, Mineral Resources, Power and Ports, and directly led the Fulbari movement of 26 August 2006. He played a part in forming several alliances of left parties and, most recently, Ganatantra Mancha. Elected a member of parliament for the first time from Brahmanbaria-6 in the 2026 election to the 13th Parliament, he joined the government.
ড, খন্দকার মোশাররফ হোসেন ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয়:
Dr Khandaker Mosharraf Hossain is the member of parliament for Cumilla-1 in the 13th Parliament. A member of the standing committee of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), he has come to Parliament for the fifth time. In 2026 he presided over the first session of the 13th Parliament. In the current Parliament he is a member of the Business Advisory Committee. He is a freedom fighter.

Khandaker Mosharraf Hossain was born on 1 October 1946 in Goyeshpur village, Daudkandi upazila, Cumilla district. He is the son of Khandaker Ashraf Ali and Hosne Ara Hasna Hena. After passing the SSC from Daudkandi High School in 1962, he obtained an MSc degree from the University of Dhaka in 1968. He later pursued higher studies at Imperial College London and obtained a PhD in geology from the University of London in 1973. In 1971 he organised Bangladeshis living in the United Kingdom to build world opinion in support of the Liberation War, and led them as convener of the Chhatra Sangram Parishad (students' action council).

In his career he joined the Department of Geology at the University of Dhaka as a junior lecturer in 1967 and rose in stages to professor. From 1987 to 1990 he was chairman of the department. "Hussain's Method of Extension", which he devised for the structural analysis of geology, has received international recognition. He is a fellow of the Third World Academy of Sciences. He has published 21 research papers in scientific journals at home and abroad. Several of his books have been published, including Muktijuddhe Bilat Probashider Obodan ("The contribution of Bangladeshis in Britain to the Liberation War"), Amar Rajnitir Rojnamcha ("My political diary") and Sangsade Kotha Bola Jay ("One can speak in Parliament").

In 1979 he joined BNP at the call of President Ziaur Rahman. After serving as the party's student affairs secretary, joint secretary general and president of Cumilla (North) district BNP, he has been a member of the party's standing committee since 1994. He was elected a member of parliament from Cumilla four times. From 1991 to 1996 he was Minister for Power, Energy and Mineral Resources, and in 1996 he briefly served as Home Minister. From 2001 to 2006 he was Minister for Health and Family Welfare. In 2002 he became president of the 56th World Health Assembly, and he received the World Health Organization's World No Tobacco award for his contribution to the anti-tobacco campaign in the country.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament, winning 141,440 votes in Cumilla-1 with the sheaf of paddy symbol. He set up the Dr Mosharraf Foundation for education, employment and healthcare in the area. With its funding, several colleges, schools, orphanages and madrasas have been established in Daudkandi, Eliotganj, Gouripur and Titas.
ড. আ ন ম এহছানুল হক মিলন শিক্ষামন্ত্রী এ:
Dr A N M Ehsanul Hoque Milon is the Minister for Education and Minister for Primary and Mass Education, and the member of parliament for Chandpur-1. He took charge of the two ministries on 17 February 2026. As State Minister for Education in the 2001–2006 term, he became known across the country for his drive against cheating in public examinations. A writer and educationist, Milon is international affairs secretary of BNP's central executive committee.

He was born in Kachua, Chandpur; he is the son of Obaidul Haque and Mahmuda Khatun. He passed the SSC from Sher-e-Bangla Nagar Government Boys' High School in Dhaka and the HSC from Government Intermediate Technical College (now Government Science College). After a bachelor's degree in chemistry from the University of Dhaka, he went to the United States in 1982 and completed an MBA at the New York Institute of Technology. In 2018 he received a PhD in political science from the International Islamic University Malaysia; his research was on the role of technical and vocational education in the socio-economic development of Bangladesh.

Although involved in politics since his student days, he became active in national politics in the mid-1990s. He was first elected a member of parliament from Chandpur-1 in the 7th parliamentary election in 1996. In 2001 he won again, defeating the Awami League candidate, former minister Mohiuddin Khan Alamgir, by a large margin, and became State Minister for Education. His zero-tolerance policy against cheating at examination centres is regarded as a milestone in restoring discipline to public examinations.

After a long gap, elected a member of parliament for the third time from the same seat in 2026, he was given charge of the country's entire education sector, from schools to universities.
ড. আবদুল মঈন খান স্থানীয় সরকার, পল্লী উ:
Dr. Abdul Moyeen Khan is Minister for Local Government, Rural Development and Co-operatives and MP for Narsingdi-2. He was sworn in as minister on 21 August 2026. An academic turned politician, he has been elected MP five times.

He was born on 1 January 1947 in Palash, Narsingdi. His father, Abdul Momen Khan, was the country's Cabinet Secretary, a founding member of the BNP and Food Minister in President Ziaur Rahman's cabinet; his mother is Khorsheda Begum. After completing his higher secondary education at Notre Dame College, Dhaka, he obtained a PhD from the University of Sussex in the United Kingdom in 1973.

Before entering politics he was a professor of physics at the University of Dhaka. He was first elected MP from Narsingdi-2 in the election to the 5th Parliament in 1991, and won the same seat again in 1996 and 2001. In Khaleda Zia's third cabinet he was Minister for Science and Information and Communication Technology. In 1998 he became a member of the Parliamentary Standing Committee on the Ministry of Planning.

Although defeated in the 2008 and 2018 elections, he remained active in the party's central politics; in December 2009 he became a member of the standing committee, the BNP's highest policy-making forum. He was always at the forefront of the party's contacts with foreign diplomats. In the 13th parliamentary election he was elected again from Narsingdi-2.
ড. নিলোফার চৌধুরী মনি ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সং:
Dr Nilufar Chowdhury Moni is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-10 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament for the second time on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament she is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting.

Nilufar Chowdhury Moni was born on 15 August 1969 in Pathalia village, Jamalpur district. She is the daughter of Nazrul Islam Chowdhury and Kohinoor Chowdhury.

She obtained a master's degree in political science from the University of Dhaka in 1995 and an LLB from the same university in 1998. In 2011 she obtained a PhD for research on women's empowerment. She is a lawyer by profession.

Nilufar Chowdhury Moni is an assistant secretary of the BNP central committee and chief coordinator of the Bangladesh Jatiyatabadi Torun Projonmo Dal (Bangladesh Nationalist Young Generation Party). In 2009 she was a BNP-nominated member of parliament for women's seat 37 in the 9th Parliament. Her name was on the BNP's announced list for the reserved women's seats in the 13th Parliament as a former member of parliament. She became the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-10 through the votes of the members of parliament. She is the mother of two children.
ডাঃ মোঃ শফিকুর রহমান ঢাকা-১৫ আসন থেকে নি:
Dr Md Shafiqur Rahman is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Dhaka-15 and Leader of the Opposition in Parliament. He is the ameer of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. This is his first term in Parliament. In Parliament he is a member of the Business Advisory Committee and the Standing Committee on Privileges.

Shafiqur Rahman was born on 31 October 1958 in Bhatera Union, Kulaura Upazila, Moulvibazar District. His father is Md. Abru Mia. He is the third of four siblings.

He passed his SSC in 1974 from the local Baramchal High School and his HSC in 1976 from Murarichand (MC) College, Sylhet. In 1983 he obtained his MBBS degree from Sylhet Medical College. He is a physician by profession.

In 1977 he joined Bangladesh Islami Chhatra Shibir and served as president of its Sylhet Medical College branch and later of its Sylhet branch. He joined Jamaat-e-Islami in 1984 and served as its ameer for Sylhet. He took on the posts of central assistant secretary general in 2010, acting secretary general in 2011 and secretary general in 2016. On 12 November 2019 he was elected ameer of the party, and he was re-elected ameer for a third term, for the 2025–2028 term.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Dhaka-15 with 85,131 votes under the scales symbol.

Alongside politics, he has been involved in founding and running various service institutions, notably Sylhet Women's Medical College. In 1985 he married Amena Begum, who was a member of the 8th Parliament in a reserved seat. The couple have two daughters and a son.
ডা. আবু মনসুর সাখাওয়াত হাসান হবিগঞ্জ-২:
Dr Abu Mansur Sakhawat Hassan is the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Habiganj-2. A physician and politician, Sakhawat Hassan is serving in Parliament for the first time, as a member of the 13th Parliament.

He was born on 5 December 1956 in Kamalkhani village, Baniachong upazila, Habiganj district. He is the son of Toyobul Hasan and Foyezunnesa Hasan. By profession he is a physician.

He has long been involved in BNP politics. Within the party he served as organising secretary for Sylhet division and later became a member of the BNP chairperson's advisory council. He also contested the 2008 parliamentary election.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament for the first time, winning 126,583 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. He is married to Rabeya Sultana and is the father of two sons and a daughter.
ডা. এস,এম, রফিকুল ইসলাম, যিনি রফিকুল ইসল:
Dr S.M. Rafiqul Islam, known as Rafiqul Islam Bachchu, is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Gazipur-3 (Sreepur Upazila and part of Gazipur Sadar). This is his first term in Parliament, as the nominee of the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). In September 2026 he was nominated chair of the Parliamentary Standing Committee on the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

He was born on 12 May 1963 in Sreepur, Gazipur District. His father is Shamsuddin Ahmed and his mother Razia Khatun. He is a physician by profession and has long been involved in politics alongside his medical practice.

Rafiqul Islam is assistant health affairs secretary of the BNP's central executive committee and first joint convener of the Gazipur District BNP.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Gazipur-3 with 162,343 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. With this victory a BNP candidate won the seat after a long gap of 47 years.
ডা. কে এম বাবর গোপালগঞ্জ-২ (গোপালগঞ্জ সদ:
Dr K M Babor is a Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Gopalganj-2 (Gopalganj Sadar and part of Kashiani). This is his first term, in the 13th Parliament. Locally he is also known as ‘Dr Babor, the doctor of the poor’.

K M Babor was born on 25 January 1982 in Gopinathpur village, Majhigati Union, Gopalganj Sadar Upazila. His father is Md. Surat Ali Khan and his mother Momejan Begum. He is a physician by profession.

Having risen in politics from the grassroots, this physician received the BNP nomination and stood as a candidate for Gopalganj-2. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for the first time, with 40,048 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.

In his personal life he is the father of a son and a daughter. His wife, Dr Rabeya Akter, is also a physician by profession.
ডা. সানসিলা জেবরিন ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Dr Sunsila Jabrin is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-15 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament for the first time on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). She is a joint convener of the Sherpur district BNP.

Sunsila Jabrin Priyanka was born on 22 June 1993 in Sherpur district. Her father, Dr Md. Hazrat Ali, is general secretary of the Sherpur district BNP. Her mother is Nilufa Khanam.

She passed the SSC in 2008 and the HSC in 2010 from Agrani School and College in Dhaka. In 2016 she obtained an MBBS degree from Anwer Khan Modern Medical College. A physician by profession, Priyanka has worked as an honorary medical officer at Dhaka Medical College and served as a lecturer in the microbiology department of Anwer Khan Modern Medical College in Dhanmondi. She is a member of the Doctors Association of Bangladesh.

In the election to the 11th Parliament in 2018 she contested Sherpur-1 as the BNP candidate, becoming the youngest candidate in the country. In the 2026 election to the 13th Parliament she was again the BNP candidate for Sherpur-1. On 20 April 2026 the BNP nominated her for a reserved women's seat. She became the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-15 through the votes of the members of parliament and took the oath on 5 May 2026.
তারেক রহমান বাংলাদেশের প্রধানমন্ত্রী, সং:
Tarique Rahman is Prime Minister of Bangladesh, Leader of the House and chairman of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). He was sworn in as Prime Minister on 17 February 2026. He is the eldest son of former President Ziaur Rahman and former Prime Minister Khaleda Zia, and is also known as Tarique Zia.

He was born in Dhaka on 20 November 1968; his ancestral home is in Gabtali, Bogura. After his SSC at Dhaka Residential Model College and his higher secondary education at Adamjee Cantonment College, he was admitted to the University of Dhaka in the 1985–86 academic session, first in the Department of Law and later in the Department of International Relations. He left his studies in the second year of his undergraduate course and went into business in the textile and shipping sectors.

His political career began in 1988 as a primary member of the Gabtali Upazila BNP. He was active in the party's campaign across the country in the 1991 and 2001 elections. In 2002 he became senior joint secretary general of the BNP, and on 8 December 2009 he was elected senior vice-chairman at the party's fifth national council. He later served as the party's acting chairman from London.

He was arrested in 2007 under the army-backed caretaker government and, after his release in September 2008 following about eighteen months, went to London for medical treatment. Between 2007 and 2024, 84 cases were filed against him, in some of which he was convicted; the BNP had consistently called them politically motivated. After the July 2024 mass uprising, the courts acquitted him in all the cases and set aside the sentences.

After nearly seventeen years abroad, he returned home on 25 December 2025 with his wife Zubaida Rahman and daughter Zaima Rahman. He became the party's chairman on 9 January 2026. In that year's parliamentary election the BNP under his leadership won two-thirds of the seats; he himself won both seats, Dhaka-17 and Bogura-6, and later gave up the Bogura seat. As Prime Minister he has also kept charge of the Cabinet Division and of the Ministry of Defence and the Armed Forces Division. In April 2026 Time magazine included him in its list of the world's 100 most influential people.
দীপেন দেওয়ান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে পার্:
Dipen Dewan is the member of parliament for the hill district seat of Rangamati in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). When the new cabinet led by Prime Minister Tarique Rahman was formed on 17 February 2026, he was sworn in as Minister for Chittagong Hill Tracts Affairs, and he held this office until 1 June.

Dipen Dewan was born into a political family on 8 June 1963 in Rangamati hill district. His father, the late Subimal Dewan, was adviser on tribal affairs to President Ziaur Rahman and a founding leader of the Rangamati district BNP. His mother, the late Mohini Dewan, was a homemaker. He belongs to the Chakma community.

After passing the SSC in 1978 he completed his higher secondary education at Rangamati Government College. While studying there he was one of the founding organisers of the college unit of the Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal. He later obtained LLB and LLM degrees from the Department of Law of the University of Dhaka. He joined the 7th BCS (Judicial) cadre and served as a judge for 19 years.

In 2005 he resigned from the post of joint district judge and joined the BNP. In 2010 he became president of the Rangamati district BNP, and since 2016 he has served as joint secretary for religious affairs on the party's central committee. He is a member of the BNP national executive committee.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected for the Rangamati seat, winning 201,544 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. His margin over the nearest candidate was 170,322 votes, the largest margin in the country in this election. He is married to Moitri Chakma and is the father of two daughters, Aditi and Rajeshwari Dewan.
দেওয়ান মোহাম্মদ সালাউদ্দিন ঢাকা-১৯ আসন:
Dewan Mohammod Salahuddin is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Dhaka-19. This BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party) leader has become an MP for the third time. He was previously elected in 1996 and 2001 from what was then Dhaka-12.

He was born on 1 October 1962 in Jirabo village, Yearpur Union, Savar Upazila, Dhaka. His father is Dewan Md. Idris and his mother Saleha Idris; he is the second of six children. He entered Momenshahi Cadet College in 1974 and passed his SSC in 1978 and his HSC in 1980. In 1987 he obtained his MBBS degree from Mymensingh Medical College.

In 1991, having passed the 10th BCS (Health) examination, he joined Itna Upazila Health Complex in Kishoreganj as a medical officer, and in 1993 he was transferred to Savar Upazila Health Complex. On 1 January 1996 he voluntarily left government service. A physician, Salahuddin is also known as a writer; he has written about 15 books on various subjects, notable among them Smritite America, Ek Jibone Ami and Rajnitir Mathe Ghate.

He entered politics in 1990 and became president of the Yearpur Union BNP and, in 2011, of the Ashulia Thana BNP. From 2016 to 2022 he served as president of the Dhaka District BNP. While a member of the 7th Parliament, he became a member of the Parliamentary Standing Committee on the Ministry of Health in January 2000.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Dhaka-19 with 190,976 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.

His initiatives to spread education are notable. In 1993 he founded Saleha Idris Primary School, named after his mother, in Srikhandia village, Ashulia; it later became a government school. He founded Jirabo Dewan Idris College in 1996, Dewan Idris Law College in Savar in 2003 and Nischintapur Dewan Idris High School in 2006. In 1992 he married Sabina Siddika Rita; the couple have two children.
নায়াব ইউসুফ আহমেদ ফরিদপুর-৩ (ফরিদপুর সদ:
Nayab Yusuf Ahmed is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Faridpur-3 (Faridpur Sadar). This is her first term in Parliament, as the nominee of the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). She is one of the seven women who won by direct vote in the 2026 election. In Parliament she is a member of the House Committee, the Library Committee, and Sub-committees No. 3 and No. 4 of the Library Committee.

Known as Nayab Yusuf, she was born on 3 February 1970. She is a member of the Biswas Estate family of Faridpur. Her father, Chowdhury Kamal Ibne Yusuf (1940–2020), was a vice-chairman of the BNP, a three-time member of parliament and Minister for Food and Disaster Management and Relief. Her mother is Shaila Kamal. Nayab, her parents' elder daughter, has a brother, Chowdhury Saud Yusuf.

In politics she is a member of the BNP's National Executive Committee and assistant organising secretary for Faridpur Division.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, she was elected MP for Faridpur-3 with 148,545 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
নাসির উদ্দিন আহমেদ মৌলভীবাজার-১ (বড়লেখা:
Nasir Uddin Ahmed is the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Maulvibazar-1 (Barlekha and Juri). Known as Nasir Uddin Ahmed Mithu, this businessman, industrialist and politician is serving in Parliament for the first time, as a member of the 13th Parliament.

He was born in 1965. He is the son of Aftab Uddin Ahmad and Amena Khatun. By profession he is a businessman and industrialist.

In party politics he is a former vice-president of Maulvibazar district BNP and a member of the district BNP's convening committee.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament for the first time, winning 98,282 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
নাসের রহমান মৌলভীবাজার-৩ (মৌলভীবাজার সদর:
Nasser Rahman is the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Maulvibazar-3 (Moulvibazar Sadar and Rajnagar). Known as M. Nasser Rahman, the politician is serving in Parliament for the second time. In the 13th Parliament he is chair of the standing committee on the Ministry of Land.

Nasser Rahman was born on 29 August 1962. His father, M. Saifur Rahman, was a former finance minister of Bangladesh and a member of parliament. His mother was the late Durre Samad Rahman. By profession he is a businessman.

In the 2001 general election his father won two seats, Sylhet-1 and Maulvibazar-3, and kept Sylhet-1. In the Maulvibazar-3 by-election in November 2001, Nasser Rahman was elected a member of parliament for the first time. He is president of the Saifur Rahman Foundation.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament for the second time, winning 156,757 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. He is married to Regina Rahman.
নিপুন রায় চৌধুরী ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Nipun Roy Chowdhury is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-11 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament for the first time on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). She is general secretary of the Dhaka district BNP and a member of the BNP central executive committee. In Parliament she is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Religious Affairs.

Nipun Roy Chowdhury was born on 29 October 1987. She grew up in a political family. Her father, Advocate Nitai Roy Chowdhury, is a vice-chairman of the BNP, the member of parliament for Magura-2 and Minister for Cultural Affairs. Her mother is Jhumur Roy Chowdhury. Her father-in-law, Goyasawar Chandra Roy, is a member of the BNP's national standing committee and the member of parliament for Dhaka-3.

She is a former student of Eden Mohila College and a lawyer by profession. She has been active in politics since her student days. Alongside her post in the Dhaka district BNP, she serves as president of the South Keraniganj BNP and as secretary of the Women and Children's Rights Forum.

Nipun Roy is one of the 36 people the BNP nominated for the reserved women's seats in the 13th Parliament. She became the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-11 through the votes of the members of parliament. Her brother, Debashish Roy Chowdhury, is a justice of the Supreme Court.
নুরুল আমিন ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে চট্টগ্র:
Nurul Amin is the member of parliament for Chattogram-1 (Mirsharai) in the 13th Parliament. Locally he is known as Nurul Amin Chairman. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Religious Affairs.

Nurul Amin was born on 10 January 1968 in Patakot, in Osmanpur union of Mirsharai upazila, Chattogram. He is the son of Abul Khair and Talimer Nesa. He is a businessman by profession.

His career as an elected representative began in local government. In 1998 he was elected a member of the Osmanpur union parishad, and in 2003 chairman of the same union parishad. In 2014 he was elected chairman of the Mirsharai upazila parishad. Within the party he has served as general secretary of the Mirsharai upazila BNP. He also received the BNP nomination in the election to the 11th Parliament in 2018.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected member of parliament for Chattogram-1 as the BNP candidate, winning 128,799 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. He is married to Nur Nahar and is the father of four sons and three daughters.
নেওয়াজ হালিমা আরলী ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদ:
Newaz Halima Arly is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-5 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament for the second time on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). She is assistant relief and rehabilitation secretary of the central BNP. In Parliament she is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Road Transport and Bridges.

Newaz Halima Arly was born on 30 August 1969 in Char Goalpara village, Sreepur upazila, Magura district. She is the daughter of Afsar Uddin Ahmed and Khurshida Parvin. She is a lawyer by profession.

In the 8th Parliament she was a BNP-nominated member of parliament for women's seat 38. Her name was on the BNP's announced list of 36 for the reserved women's seats in the 13th Parliament as a former member of parliament. She became the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-5 through the votes of the members of parliament.
প্রফেসর ড. মোঃ ইলিয়াস মোল্লা ফরিদপুর-১:
Professor Dr Md. Elias Molla is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Faridpur-1 (Madhukhali, Boalmari and Alfadanga). This is his first term in Parliament, as the nominee of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. He is an academic and a former chairman of the Department of Chemistry at Jahangirnagar University.

He was born in Kalpoha village, Kamaldia Union, Madhukhali Upazila, Faridpur District. His father is Abdul Majid Molla and his mother Saleha Begum. He is the second of five siblings. He won talent-pool scholarships in Class 5 and Class 8, and passed his SSC and HSC in the first division with letter marks.

From the Department of Chemistry at Jahangirnagar University he came first in the first class in his bachelor's (Hons) examination and obtained a first class in his MSc. In 1981 he joined the same university as a lecturer. Awarded a Commonwealth Scholarship in 1984, he obtained his PhD from the University of Sussex, England, in 1987, and he received the Hariprasanna Gold Medal from the University of Dhaka. In 1992 he carried out postdoctoral research in England on a Royal Society of Chemistry fellowship; in 1993 he was promoted to professor; and from 1995 to 1997 he carried out postdoctoral research for a second time, at the University of Bayreuth in Germany, on an Alexander von Humboldt Fellowship. From 2012 to 2015 he was chairman of the Department of Chemistry at Jahangirnagar University. About 100 of his research papers have been published in national and international journals, and many students have obtained doctorates under his supervision.

He has been associated with Islami Chhatra Shibir since its founding in 1977 and was the second president of its Jahangirnagar University branch. He is currently a member of the Shura and of the executive council of Jamaat-e-Islami's Dhaka District branch.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Faridpur-1 with 154,145 votes under the scales symbol.
ফাহমিদা হক ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে সংরক্ষি:
Fahmida Haq is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-18 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament for the first time on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament she is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting.

Fahmida Haq was born on 1 March 1978. She is the daughter of Zahirul Haque and Shirin Haque. She holds a BSc. She is a writer and analyst by profession.

Her husband, Zillur Rahman, is the presenter of the television talk show Tritiyo Matra. Fahmida Haq is one of the 36 people the BNP nominated for the reserved women's seats in the 13th Parliament. She became the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-18 through the votes of the members of parliament.
ফেরদৌসী আহমেদ ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে সংরক:
Ferdousy Ahmed is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-23 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament for the first time on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). She is a joint convener of the Dhaka Metropolitan North BNP.

Ferdousy Ahmed Mishti was born on 15 January 1974. She is the daughter of Haji Md. Nizamuddin Ahmed and Haji Mst. Hosne Ara Ahmed. She obtained a bachelor's degree from Begum Badrunnesa Government Women's College. She is a businesswoman by profession.

During her college years she was an active worker of the Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal and was elected AGS (assistant general secretary) of the college students' union. Her brother, the late Nasir Uddin Ahmed Pintu, was a BNP leader. Her husband, Saidur Rahman Newton, was the councillor for ward 8 of Dhaka North City Corporation. After her husband's death Ferdousy Ahmed was herself elected councillor and carried out development work in the area. She is active in politics in the Mirpur area.

Ferdousy Ahmed is one of the 36 people the BNP nominated for the reserved women's seats in the 13th Parliament. She became the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-23 through the votes of the members of parliament.
ববি হাজ্জাজ প্রাথমিক ও গণশিক্ষা প্রতিমন্:
Bobby Hajjaj is State Minister for Primary and Mass Education and MP for Dhaka-13. He has held this post since 4 March 2026. An Oxford-educated researcher and columnist, he is the founding chairman of the Nationalist Democratic Movement (NDM); in the 2026 election he won as a BNP candidate.

He was born and raised in Dhaka. His father is the businessman Musa Bin Shamsher and his mother Kaniz Fatema Chowdhury. After his schooling at Maple Leaf International School, he took a bachelor's degree in political science from the University of Texas at Austin in the United States. He later completed an MBA at the University of Oxford in 2006 and carried out postgraduate research in strategy there.

After graduating, he worked for a year in the financial sector in the United States before returning home. From 2003 he worked for several years as a business development and strategy consultant in America, Europe and the Middle East. From late 2009, based in Bangladesh, he was a lecturer and researcher in business strategy at North South University, and wrote regularly for The Daily Star, The Daily Independent and the Dhaka Tribune. In 2015 he launched ‘Swapner Desh’, a civic empowerment initiative involving young people.

In 2012 he became special adviser to former President H. M. Ershad. He came to public attention for his criticism of the 2014 election; in late 2013 RAB detained him for 20 hours. In April 2017 he formed the NDM party. In the 13th parliamentary election of 2026 he was elected MP for the first time, from Dhaka-13 under the sheaf of paddy symbol. His wife is Barrister Rashna Imam; they have two daughters.
বিলকিস ইসলাম ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে সংরক্:
Bilkis Islam is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-7 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament for the second time on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). She is a member of the BNP executive committee. In Parliament she is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Women and Children Affairs.

Bilkis Islam was born on 1 January 1956 in Panialpukur village, Kishoreganj upazila, Nilphamari district. She is the daughter of Khayer Uddin Ahmed and Khayetunnesa.

In the 8th Parliament she was a BNP-nominated member of parliament for women's seat 15. She became the member of parliament for this seat in 2005. Her name was on the BNP's announced list of 36 for the reserved women's seats in the 13th Parliament as a former member of parliament. She became the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-7 through the votes of the members of parliament.
বীর মুক্তিযোদ্ধা মোঃ নাছির চৌধুরী সুনামগ:
Freedom fighter Md Nasir Chowdhury is a Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Sunamganj-2 (Derai and Sulla). The 13th Parliament is his second term.

Nasir Chowdhury was born on 2 June 1950. His father is Md. Gias Uddin Chowdhury and his mother Aftarun Nesa Khanam. Politics is his profession.

This veteran politician is a member of the BNP's central executive committee. In local government he was twice elected chairman of the upazila parishad. He was first elected MP in the election to the 7th Parliament held in June 1996. In all he has contested five parliamentary elections.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for the second time, with 99,522 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. After the result was announced, his nearest rival, the Jamaat-e-Islami candidate Mohammad Shishir Manir, congratulated him.
বীর মুক্তিযোদ্ধা মোহাম্মদ আব্দুল মালিক স:
Freedom fighter Mohammed Abdul Malique is the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Sylhet-3 (Dakshin Surma, Balaganj and Fenchuganj). Known as M. A. Malik, the politician is serving in Parliament for the first time, as a member of the 13th Parliament.

Abdul Malique was born on 12 November 1957 at Tilabari in Tetli, Dakshin Surma upazila, Sylhet district. He is the son of Mohammed Konu Mia and Ariza Begum.

A long-time resident of the United Kingdom, this expatriate politician has served as general secretary and as president of UK BNP. He has also served as an adviser to the BNP chairperson and as chief adviser to the Bangladesh Jatiyatabadi Byabsayi Dal (Bangladesh Nationalist Business Party).

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament for the first time, winning 114,255 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. He is one of three expatriate leaders who won on BNP nominations in Sylhet division.
ব্যারিস্টার মীর মোহাম্মদ হেলাল উদ্দীন (ম:
Barrister Mir Mohammed Helal Uddin (Mir Helal) is the State Minister for Chittagong Hill Tracts Affairs and for Land, and the member of parliament for Chattogram-5.
