He became State Minister for Chittagong Hill Tracts Affairs on 17 February 2026 and on 12 March was also given charge of the Ministry of Land. A Supreme Court lawyer and UK-trained barrister, he is assistant organising secretary (Chattogram division) of the BNP national executive committee.

He was born on 12 August 1982 and comes from the Mir Bari of Mirer Khil in Hathazari, Chattogram. His father, Mir Mohammed Nasir Uddin, is a former State Minister for Civil Aviation and Tourism and a former mayor of Chattogram City Corporation; his mother is Dalia Naznin Nasir. He is his parents' only son. He completed the Bar-at-Law as a member of Lincoln's Inn in the United Kingdom.

Within the party he is special assistant to the chairperson's foreign affairs advisory committee and a member of the BNP media cell. He is a director of the Ziaur Rahman Foundation and convener of the Legal Research Cell founded by Tarique Rahman.

In 2007 he was convicted, together with his father, in an Anti-Corruption Commission assets case; after a long legal process, the Appellate Division of the Supreme Court acquitted both father and son in September 2025. In the 2026 election he was elected member of parliament for the first time, winning 147,054 votes in Chattogram-5.
ব্যারিস্টার সাকিলা ফারজানা ত্রয়োদশ জাতী:
Barrister Shakila Farzana is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-8 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament for the first time on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament she is a member of the special committee on amending the Constitution and of the standing committee on the Ministry of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs.

Her father, Syed Wahidul Alam, was the member of parliament for Chattogram-5 from 1991 to 2006 and served as a BNP Whip from 2001 to 2006. Her mother is Farida Wahid. Shakila Farzana passed the SSC from Bangladesh Mohila Samity Girls' High School in Chattogram and the HSC from Chittagong College. After obtaining LLB and LLM degrees from the University of Chittagong, she obtained a second LLB degree from the University of London and completed the Bar Vocational Course at City University, London.

A lawyer by profession, Shakila Farzana practises in the High Court Division of the Supreme Court. Early in her career she worked for two years with Barrister Rafique-ul Huq and for more than four years with Barrister Rokanuddin Mahmud. In 2008 she set up her own law firm, Law Cornerstone. She is a member of the Dhaka District Bar Association and the Supreme Court Bar Association.

In politics she has served as joint general secretary of the Supreme Court unit of the Jatiyatabadi Ainjibi Forum, the organisation of pro-BNP lawyers. In April 2026 the BNP nominated her for a reserved women's seat. She became the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-8 through the votes of the members of parliament. Her husband, Md. Bahauddin, is a Chattogram-based businessman. The couple have two children.
মনজুর এলাহী নরসিংদী-৩ (শিবপুর) আসন থেকে:
Monjur Elahi is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Narsingdi-3 (Shibpur). This is his first term in Parliament, as the nominee of the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). He is general secretary of the Narsingdi District BNP and, in Parliament, a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Industries.

He was born on 1 June 1972 in Narsingdi Sadar Upazila, Narsingdi District. His father is Abed Ali Mia and his mother Momeza Begum. In December 2025 the BNP gave him its final nomination for Narsingdi-3.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Narsingdi-3 with 82,061 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মাহ্‌মুদা হাবীবা ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে স:
Mahmuda Habiba is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-13 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament for the first time on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). She is joint general secretary of the central committee of the Jatiyatabadi Krishak Dal and a member of the BNP media cell.

Mahmuda Habiba was born on 18 March 1973. Her father, Muhammad Ayen Ud-Din, was the member of parliament for Rajshahi-4 from 1986 to 1988. Her mother is Nurmahal Khatun. She is a businesswoman by profession.

She is a member of the convening committee of the Rajshahi district BNP. Mahmuda Habiba is one of the 36 people the BNP nominated for the reserved women's seats in the 13th Parliament. She became the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-13 through the votes of the members of parliament.
মিয়া নুরুদ্দিন আহাম্মেদ অপু শরীয়তপুর-৩:
Miah Nuruddin Ahmad Apu is a Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Shariatpur-3 and a Whip in the 13th Parliament. This is his first term in Parliament. He also serves as a member of the House Committee, the Special Committee and the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Home Affairs.

Nuruddin Apu was born on 1 October 1974 in Kodalpur Union, Gosairhat Upazila, Shariatpur District. His father is Mia Chan Mridha and his mother Amena Begum.

He has long been involved in politics. He has served as private secretary to BNP chairman Tarique Rahman. He was the BNP candidate for Shariatpur-3 in the 2018 election to the 11th Parliament.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for the first time, with 107,516 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. The President later appointed him a Whip of Parliament.
মীর আহমাদ বিনকাসেম, যিনি ব্যারিস্টার আরম:
Mir Ahmad Binquasem, also known as Barrister Arman, is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Dhaka-14. This is his first term in Parliament, as the nominee of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Library Committee and Sub-committee No. 1 of the Library Committee.

He was born on 18 March 1984. His father is Mir Quasem Ali and his mother Khandaker Ayesha Khatun.

Mir Ahmad Binquasem obtained an LLB (Hons) degree from the University of London. He later completed the Bar Vocational Course at the Inns of Court School of Law and was enrolled as a barrister at the Bar of England and Wales. On returning home from the United Kingdom he took up the practice of law. Besides being a lawyer and politician, he is also known as a human rights activist.

At the call of Jamaat's ameer, Shafiqur Rahman, he began campaigning in Dhaka-14, and he received the party's nomination in October 2025. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP with 101,113 votes under the scales symbol.
মুন্সী রফিকুল আলম ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Munshi Rafiqul Alam is the member of parliament for Feni-1 (Parshuram, Chhagalnaiya and Fulgazi upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In political circles he is known as Rafiqul Alam Majnu. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Water Resources.

Rafiqul Alam was born on 1 March 1972 in Izzatpur village, Feni Sadar upazila. He is the son of Munshi Golam Mostafa and Rezia Begum. He holds a master's degree in management. By profession he is a businessman and the owner of several businesses.

In politics he has served as president of Jubo Dal and is currently convener of Dhaka Metropolitan South BNP. He has also served as the party's organisational coordinator for the Feni-1 seat.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament, winning 119,904 votes in Feni-1 with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মুশফিকুর রহমান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে ব্র:
Mushfiqur Rahman is the member of parliament for Brahmanbaria-4 (Akhaura and Kasba upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the second time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he is chair of the standing committee on the Ministry of Finance.

Mushfiqur Rahman was born on 8 January 1940 in the western para (neighbourhood) of Chhatura Sharif village, Akhaura upazila, Brahmanbaria. He is the son of Md. Muniruzzaman and Hamidunnesa.

In his career he was an officer in the administration cadre of the Pakistan civil service (CSS). Over a long administrative career he served as assistant commissioner, deputy secretary, joint secretary, additional secretary and secretary. He later became an alternate executive director of the World Bank. He is also one of the founders of the private television channel Desh TV.

Entering politics after his retirement, he served as an adviser to Brahmanbaria district BNP and as an adviser to the BNP chairperson. In the 8th parliamentary election in 2001 he was elected a member of parliament for the first time, from the Brahmanbaria-4 seat. In the 8th Parliament too he was chair of the parliamentary standing committee on the Ministry of Finance.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament for the second time, winning 139,842 votes in Brahmanbaria-4 with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মুস্তাফিজুর রহমান ভূঁইয়া, যিনি মোস্তাফি:
Mustafizur Rahman Bhuiyan, known as Mostafizur Rahman Bhuiyan Dipu, is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Narayanganj-1. This is his first term in Parliament, as the nominee of the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Industries.

He was born on 2 April 1976 into the Bhuiyan family of Rupganj. His grandfather, Golbaksh Bhuiyan, was one of the leading businessmen of what was then East Pakistan. His father, Majibur Rahman Bhuiyan, was the proprietor of the Gausia Group and chairman of the Rupganj Upazila Parishad. His mother is Shamsun Nahar.

Dipu, who holds an MBA from North South University, is an industrialist by profession and a director of Gausia Corporation. In 2025 he was elected president of the Narayanganj Chamber of Commerce and Industry and chairman of the board of directors of Bangladesh Real Estate Club Limited for the 2025–2026 term.

In politics he is a member of the BNP's executive committee. In 2025 he became senior joint convener of the Narayanganj District BNP.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Narayanganj-1 with 158,358 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ আবদুল মান্নান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Md Abdul Mannan is the member of parliament for Brahmanbaria-5 (Nabinagar upazila) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change.

Abdul Mannan was born on 1 July 1959 in Nabinagar upazila, Brahmanbaria district. He is the son of Jinnat Ali Bhuiyan and Mst. Ayesha Khatun. By profession he is a lawyer.

In politics he has served as president of Nabinagar upazila BNP and also as convener of Brahmanbaria district BNP. In November 2025 the party nominated him as its candidate for the Brahmanbaria-5 seat.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament, winning 85,769 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. With this, a BNP party candidate was elected member of parliament from the Nabinagar seat for the first time in nearly 30 years.
মোঃ আবদুল হান্নান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Md Abdul Hannan is the independent member of parliament for Chandpur-4 (Faridganj upazila) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time and is known locally as M. A. Hannan. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Liberation War Affairs.

Abdul Hannan was born on 27 July 1962 in Faridganj upazila, Chandpur district. He is the son of Ashek Ali and Angkurer Nesa. By profession he is a businessman.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected member of parliament for Chandpur-4 as an independent candidate, winning 74,175 votes with the prawn symbol.
মোঃ আবুল কালাম ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে কুম:
Md Abul Kalam is the member of parliament for Cumilla-9 (Laksam and Monohorgonj upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he is chair of the standing committee on the Ministry of Industries and a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Commerce.

Abul Kalam was born on 31 December 1961. He is the son of Alhaj Wali Ullah Mia and Alhaj Arusa Khatun. By profession he is a businessman.

In politics he is industrial affairs secretary of BNP's national executive committee. According to his own website, he has been involved in public service for more than 25 years and is giving priority to education, healthcare, infrastructure development and creating opportunities for young people in his constituency.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament, winning 170,008 votes in Cumilla-9 with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ আবুল খায়ের ভূঁইয়া ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয়:
Md Abul Khair Bhuiyan is the member of parliament for Laxmipur-2 (Raipur upazila and part of Lakshmipur Sadar upazila) in the 13th Parliament. This experienced politician of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has been elected a member of parliament from this seat for the fourth time. He is an adviser to the BNP chairperson. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology and of the committee on private members' bills and private members' resolutions.

Khair Bhuiyan is the son of Mazharul Islam Bhuiyan and Rezia Begum. By profession he is a businessman. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected from Laxmipur-2 as the BNP candidate, winning 146,321 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ আবুল হাসনাত ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে কু:
Md. Abul Hasnat is the member of parliament for Cumilla-4 (Debidwar upazila) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time, from the National Citizen Party (NCP). He is better known as Hasnat Abdullah. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Finance and of two other parliamentary committees.

Hasnat was born on 13 September 1998 in Debidwar, Cumilla. He is the son of Md. Jalal Uddin and Jahanara Yasmin. After passing the secondary examination in the science stream in 2014 from Debidwar Government Reaz Uddin Pilot Model High School and the higher secondary examination from Paruara Abdul Matin Khasru College, he was admitted to the Department of English at the University of Dhaka.

As a student leader he was one of the coordinators of the 2024 quota reform movement and later served as convener of the Students Against Discrimination movement. In the National Citizen Party, formed after the July mass uprising, he was given the post of chief organiser for the southern region.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament as the NCP candidate, winning 166,583 votes in Cumilla-4.
মোঃ আব্দুল বাতেন, যিনি কর্নেল আব্দুল বাত:
Md Abdul Baten, known as Colonel Abdul Baten (retd), is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Dhaka-16. This is his first term in Parliament, as the nominee of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Home Affairs and the Special Committee.

He was born in 1953. His father is Sharif Uddin and his mother Shakila Begum. After his primary schooling at Notabari High School, he completed his secondary education at Pirgacha Gyanendra Narayan Government Model High School and his higher secondary education in 1970 at Carmichael College, Rangpur. In 1976 he obtained bachelor's and master's degrees in Bangla from the University of Rajshahi.

His career began as a teacher at BAF Shaheen College Kurmitola. He later joined the Bangladesh Army as an education officer, served as an instructor at the Bangladesh Military Academy and worked for a year on a United Nations mission for the army. In 1999 he became principal of Chattogram Cantonment Public College; he was later principal of Cantonment Public School and College, Rangpur, and finally principal of Shaheed Bir Uttom Lt. Anwar Girls' College, after which he retired in 2007. A retired army officer and educationist, Abdul Baten is also known as a writer, translator and businessman.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Dhaka-16 with 88,828 votes under the scales symbol.
মোঃ আশরাফ উদ্দিন, যিনি আশরাফ উদ্দিন বকুল:
Md Ashraf Uddin, known as Ashraf Uddin Bakul, is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Narsingdi-5 (Raipura). This is his first term in Parliament, as the nominee of the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). He is assistant secretary for science and technology affairs of the BNP's central committee and, in Parliament, a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting.

He was born on 22 June 1969 in Raipura Upazila, Narsingdi District. His father is Abdul Hashem Bhuiyan and his mother Saleha Begum. After receiving the nomination he pledged to work in unity with the party's grassroots leaders and activists.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Narsingdi-5 with 137,690 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. With this victory a BNP candidate won the seat after nearly 30 years.
মোঃ খালেদ হোসেন মাহবুব ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় স:
Md. Khaled Hossain Mahboob is the member of parliament for Brahmanbaria-3 (Brahmanbaria Sadar and Bijoynagar upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he is chair of the standing committee on the Ministry of Commerce.

Khaled Hossain Mahboob was born on 11 September 1967 in Sadar upazila, Brahmanbaria district. He is the son of Mohammad Ali and Samsunnahar Begum. He studied at Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (BUET) and is known as an engineer. By profession he is a businessman.

In politics he is economic affairs secretary of BNP's central executive committee and president of Brahmanbaria district BNP. He is also involved in education in the area, serving as chief adviser to Brahmanbaria Ideal School.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament, winning 209,636 votes in Brahmanbaria-3 with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ জসীম উদ্দিন ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে কু:
Md Jashim Uddin is the member of parliament for Cumilla-5 (Brahmanpara and Burichang upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). Locally he is also known as Haji Jashim Uddin.

Jashim Uddin was born on 1 March 1965 in Bagra village, Brahmanpara upazila, Cumilla district. He is the son of Nurul Islam and Anowara Begum.

He has long been in the leadership of the local BNP. Since 2000 he has served as president of Brahmanpara upazila BNP. From 2022 to 2025 he was member secretary of Cumilla South district BNP.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament, winning 134,485 votes in Cumilla-5 with the sheaf of paddy symbol. He is the father of three daughters and a son.
মোঃ জালাল উদ্দিন ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে চ:
Md Jalal Uddin is the member of parliament for Chandpur-2 (Matlab Uttar and Matlab Dakshin upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Finance and of the standing committee on public accounts.

Jalal Uddin was born on 4 January 1959 in Matlab Uttar upazila, Chandpur district. He is the son of Md. Sayed Ali Howlader and Amena Khatun. Locally he is known as Alhaj Dr Mohammad Jalal Uddin.

In politics he is a member of BNP's national executive committee. In November 2025 the party nominated him as its candidate for Chandpur-2. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament, winning 172,506 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. After the election he was given a public reception in Matlab Uttar.
মোঃ জাহান্দার আলী মিয়া মাদারীপুর-২ (মাদ:
Md Jahander Ali Miha is a Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Madaripur-2 (part of Madaripur Sadar, and Rajoir). This is his first term, in the 13th Parliament. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Education.

Jahander Ali Miha was born on 20 April 1962 in Madaripur Sadar Upazila, Madaripur District. His mother's name is Aytan Nesa. He is a businessman by profession.

In party politics he serves as member secretary of the Madaripur District BNP. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for the first time, with 61,744 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ তমিজ উদ্দিন ঢাকা-২০ (ধামরাই) আসন থেক:
Md Tamiz Uddin is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Dhaka-20 (Dhamrai). This is his first term in Parliament, as the nominee of the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology.

He was born in Dhamrai Upazila, Dhaka District. His father is Md. Afaz Uddin and his mother Sharifun Nesa. He is a businessman by profession and has long been involved in politics. He previously served as chairman of the Dhamrai Upazila Parishad. He is currently a member of the BNP's National Executive Committee and president of the Dhamrai Upazila BNP.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP with 162,504 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. In 1988 he founded Afaz Uddin School and College in Sharifbag village, Dhamrai Upazila.
মোঃ নজরুল ইসলাম আজাদ নারায়ণগঞ্জ-২ (আড়া:
Md Nazrul Islam Azad is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Narayanganj-2 (Araihazar). This is his first term in Parliament, as the nominee of the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party).

He was born on 12 December 1976 in Araihazar Upazila, Narayanganj District. He is a resident of Satgram Union, Araihazar. His father is Md. Mostafizur Rahman and his mother Shahnaz Rahman. He studied at Panchrukhi Haji Saheb Ali Fakir High School.

Nazrul Islam Azad, who is involved in BNP politics, was appointed international affairs secretary of Jatiyatabadi Jubo Dal by the party's chairperson, Begum Khaleda Zia.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Narayanganj-2 with 124,291 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ বরকত উল্লাহ বুলু ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংস:
Md. Barkat Ullah Bulu is the member of parliament for Noakhali-3 (Begumganj upazila) in the 13th Parliament. A vice-chairman of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), Bulu has come to Parliament for the fifth time. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Commerce.

Barkat Ullah Bulu was born on 20 December 1956 in Begumganj, Noakhali. His father is Abdur Rahman. His education began at Batatali Bazar Primary School, and in 1980 he obtained a bachelor's degree in science.

In politics he was central president of Jubo Dal. In 1989 he was elected a member of BNP's executive committee, and he later served as the party's central joint secretary general. He is currently a vice-chairman of the party. He was elected a member of parliament from the Noakhali-2 seat in the 5th parliamentary election in 1991 and the 6th and 7th in February and June 1996, and from the Noakhali-3 seat in the 9th parliamentary election in 2008. In the 9th Parliament he was a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Public Administration. He also served for a long time as an adviser to the Ministry of Commerce.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament for the fifth time, winning 141,031 votes in Noakhali-3 with the sheaf of paddy symbol. In 1981 he married Shamim Akter Lucky. The couple have two sons.
মোঃ মজিবুর রহমান গাজীপুর-১ আসন থেকে নির্:
Md. Mazibur Rahman is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Gazipur-1. He has entered Parliament for the first time, as the nominee of the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). He is a member of the BNP's central National Executive Committee and, in Parliament, a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting. Locally he is known as Mayor Mazibur Rahman.

He was born on 11 July 1968 in Kaliakair Upazila, Gazipur District. His father is Shukur Ali and his mother Surja Bhanu. After completing his primary and secondary education at local institutions, he obtained a master's degree (MSS) in political science. He is a businessman by profession.

His career as an elected representative began in 2004 as administrator of Kaliakair Municipality. He was later elected mayor of Kaliakair Municipality three times in a row and held the post for nearly two decades. As mayor he worked on developing the municipal area's roads, drainage and social infrastructure.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Gazipur-1 with 208,688 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ মনিরুল হক চৌধুরী ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংস:
Md Manirul Haque Chowdhury is the member of parliament for Cumilla-6 (Cumilla Adarsha Sadar, Cumilla City Corporation and the Cumilla Cantonment area) in the 13th Parliament. Elected from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), this veteran politician has come to Parliament for the fourth time. In Parliament he is chair of the standing committee on the Ministry of Liberation War Affairs. He is a freedom fighter and an organiser of the Liberation War.

Manirul Haque Chowdhury was born in Noygram, Cumilla Sadar Dakshin upazila, Cumilla district. He is the son of Md. Noab Haider Chowdhury and Joynaber Nesa.

He has been active in politics since his student days. From 1974 to 1975 he was president of the Bangladesh Chhatra League. In the 3rd parliamentary election in 1988 he was elected a member of parliament for the first time, from the Cumilla-9 seat on a Jatiya Party nomination, and he was re-elected from the same seat in the 5th parliamentary election in 1991. He later joined BNP, and in the 8th parliamentary election in 2001 he became a member of parliament for the third time, from Cumilla-9 on a BNP nomination. He has also served as an adviser to the BNP chairperson.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, standing in Cumilla-6 for the first time, he was elected a member of parliament, winning 201,706 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. He is married to Azizunnesa, and the couple have four children.
মোঃ মমিনুল হক ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে চাঁদ:
Md Maminul Haque is the member of parliament for Chandpur-5 (Hajiganj and Shaharasti upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). Locally he is known as Engineer Maminul Haque.

Maminul Haque was born in Hajiganj upazila, Chandpur district. He is the son of Alhaj Md. Lokit Ulla Sarkar and Latifa Khatun.

A politician who rose from the grassroots, he has served as convener of Hajiganj-Shaharasti BNP and as president of Chandpur district BNP. He is currently a member of BNP's central executive committee. He received BNP's nomination for Chandpur-5 in the 2008 and 2018 parliamentary elections.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, having received the party's nomination for the third time, he was elected a member of parliament, winning 185,404 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ মুজিবুর রহমান চৌধুরী মৌলভীবাজার-৪ (শ:
Md Mujibur Rahman Choudhury is the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Maulvibazar-4 (Sreemangal and Kamalganj). Known as Haji Mujib, this politician, industrialist and social worker is serving in Parliament for the first time, as a member of the 13th Parliament.

Mujibur Rahman Choudhury was born in Khushalpur village in Kamalganj municipality, Maulvibazar district. He is the son of Abdul Gafur Choudhury and Ummerunnesa.

After passing the SSC from Kamalganj Multilateral High School and the HSC from Kamalganj College, he obtained a BCom degree from the University of Dhaka. By profession he is a businessman and industrialist.

He has been a member of BNP's central executive committee since 2008. He contested this seat as an independent candidate in 2001, and was later BNP's candidate in the 2008 and 2018 elections.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament for the first time, winning 170,877 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. After his victory he dedicated it to the people of Kamalganj and Sreemangal.
মোঃ মোবাশ্বের আলম ভুঁইয়া ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয:
Md Mobasher Alam Bhuiyan is the member of parliament for Cumilla-10 (Cumilla Sadar Dakshin, Lalmai and Nangalkot upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology.

Mobasher Alam was born on 2 July 1970 in Nishchintapur village, Nangalkot upazila, Cumilla district. He is the son of Md. Abdul Latif Bhuiyan and Mst. Karimun Nesa Bhuiyan.

By profession he is a businessman. His businesses are Zamzam Car, Automobile and Hotel Okada.

In politics he has served as president of Nangalkot upazila BNP and vice-president of Cumilla South district BNP. In the 2008 election he was BNP's candidate for Cumilla-10. He is currently a member of BNP's central executive committee. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament, winning 163,667 votes in Cumilla-10 with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ শওকতুল ইসলাম মৌলভীবাজার-২ (কুলাউড়া):
Md Showkatul Islam is the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Maulvibazar-2 (Kulaura). Known as Showkatul Islam Shaku, the politician is serving in Parliament for the first time, as a member of the 13th Parliament. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Planning.

Showkatul Islam was born on 21 May 1959 in Kulaura, Maulvibazar district. He is the son of Md. Rais Ali and Maleka Khanam.

An expatriate politician, he was involved in Kulaura upazila BNP politics. In the 2001 parliamentary election he stood as a Jatiya Party candidate, and he later joined BNP.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament for the first time, winning 88,381 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. With his victory the seat returned to BNP for the first time since 1996, after nearly 30 years.
মোঃ শহিদুল ইসলাম, যিনি শহিদুল ইসলাম বাবু:
Md. Shohidul Islam, known as Shohidul Islam Babul, is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Faridpur-4. This is his first term in Parliament, as the nominee of the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). He is central general secretary of Bangladesh Jatiyatabadi Krishak Dal. In Parliament he is a member of the House Committee and the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Road Transport and Bridges.

He was born on 20 April 1971 in Nagarkanda Upazila, Faridpur District. His father is Md. Sirajul Islam Khan and his mother Mariam Begum. He describes himself as a farmer's son.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Faridpur-4 with 127,443 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. After his victory he went to the home of his rival, the Jamaat candidate Maulana Sarwar Hossain, to exchange greetings with him, and held cordial talks with supporters of both sides; this was reported as an example of harmony in the area.
মোঃ শহীদউদ্দীন চৌধুরী এ্যানি পানি সম্পদ:
Md. Shahiduddin Chowdhury Anee is the Minister for Water Resources and the member of parliament for Laxmipur-3 (Sadar). He took office as minister on 17 February 2026. A former central president of Chhatra Dal and a former acting VP of DUCSU (the Dhaka University Central Students' Union), Anee is a joint secretary general of BNP; he has been elected a member of parliament from this seat three times.

He was born on 2 February 1968 into the Chowdhury family of Banchanagar village in Lakshmipur municipality. His father, Haji Bashir Ullah Chowdhury, was a Lakshmipur businessman, and his mother is Hosne Ara Begum. Two of his paternal cousins, Shahabuddin Chowdhury and Chowdhury Khorshed Alam, were members of parliament from Lakshmipur. He passed the SSC in the science stream from Lakshmipur Adarsha Samad Government High School and the HSC from Government Science College, Dhaka. From the Department of Applied Chemistry and Chemical Technology at the University of Dhaka he obtained a bachelor's (honours) degree in 1988 and an MSc in 1989, and in 1993 he completed a diploma in education at the university's Institute of Education and Research.

In 1980, while still a schoolboy, he entered Chhatra Dal politics through President Ziaur Rahman's canal-digging programme. In 1989 he was GS (general secretary) of the Ziaur Rahman Hall students' union; in 1990 he was elected a member of DUCSU with the highest number of votes; and he was three times a student representative in the university senate. In 1992 he served as acting VP of DUCSU. From 1996 to 1998 he was central president of Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal.

In 1999 he became a member of BNP's central executive committee. Elected a member of parliament from Laxmipur-3 in 2001 and 2008, he was a member of the parliamentary standing committees on the Ministries of Education, Disaster Management and Relief, Textiles and Jute, and Science and Information Technology. After serving as the party's central student affairs secretary (2009) and publicity secretary (from 2016), he is now a joint secretary general. In 2026 he was elected a member of parliament for the third time. His wife is Parvin Akter Chowdhury; they have two sons and a daughter.
মোঃ শাহজাহান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে নোয়া:
Md Shahjahan is the member of parliament for Noakhali-4 (Subarnachar and Noakhali Sadar upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. A vice-chairman of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), Shahjahan has come to Parliament for the fifth time. In Parliament he is chair of the committee on private members' bills and resolutions.

Mohammad Shahjahan was born in Sadar upazila, Noakhali district. He is the son of Abdul Motin and Hurer Nesa.

In 1978, when BNP was founded, he became actively involved in the party's politics under President Ziaur Rahman. After serving as the party's joint secretary general, he is currently a vice-chairman and the coordinator for rebuilding the party at the grassroots. He was president of Noakhali district BNP until 2016. In 2015 he was also given responsibility for nominating the party's candidates in the municipal elections.

In the 5th parliamentary election in 1991 he was elected a member of parliament for the first time, from the Noakhali-4 seat. He was then elected from the same seat to the 6th, 7th and 8th Parliaments as well. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament for the fifth time, winning 219,182 votes in Noakhali-4 with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ শাহাদাত হোসেন, যিনি শাহাদাত হোসেন সে:
Md. Shahadat Hossain, known as Shahadat Hossain Selim, is the member of parliament for Laxmipur-1 (Ramganj) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Finance.

Shahadat Hossain Selim was born in Karpara union, Ramganj upazila, Lakshmipur district. His father is the late Alhaj Ali Hossain Mia and his mother is Saleha Begum.

Beginning his political life in Chhatra Dal, he was active in BNP politics for a long time. He later served as chairman of the Bangladesh Liberal Democratic Party (BLDP) and as spokesman of the 12-party alliance. On 8 December 2025 he dissolved his own party, rejoined BNP and received the party's nomination for the Laxmipur-1 seat.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected member of parliament for Laxmipur-1 as the BNP candidate, winning 86,811 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ সফিকুর রহমান (কিরন) শরীয়তপুর-২ (নড়:
Md. Shafiqur Rahman (Kiron) is a Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Shariatpur-2 (Naria and Sakhipur). He has been a member of Parliament once before; the 13th Parliament is his second term.

Shafiqur Rahman Kiron was born in 1965. His father is Habib Ulla Chokdar and his mother Shariatun Habib.

In party politics he is president of the Shariatpur District BNP. He was first elected MP from Shariatpur-3 in the election to the 6th Parliament held on 15 February 1996. He has long been active in Shariatpur politics and has contested several parliamentary elections.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for the second time, from Shariatpur-2 with 129,814 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোঃ সাইফুল আলম, যিনি সাইফুল আলম খান মিলন:
Md Saiful Alam, known as Saiful Alam Khan Milon, is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Dhaka-12. He has entered Parliament for the first time, as the nominee of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. In Parliament he is a member of the House Committee, the Special Committee, the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Finance and the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Planning.

He was born in 1954 in Dhaka. His father is Md. Habibur Rahman Khan and his mother Lutfun Nahar. By profession he is known as a businessman. Involved in organisational work since his student days, Saiful Alam served as central president of Bangladesh Islami Chhatra Shibir from January to December 1983.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Dhaka-12 with 53,773 votes under the scales symbol.
মোঃ সেলিম ভূইয়া ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে ক:
Md Salim Bhuiyan is the member of parliament for Cumilla-2 in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he is chair of the standing committee on the Ministry of Education.

Salim Bhuiyan was born on 16 November 1958. He is the son of Sirajul Haque Bhuiyan and Ambia Khatun. Associated with the teaching profession, Salim Bhuiyan is known as "Principal".

In politics he is organising secretary (Cumilla division) of BNP's national executive committee. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament, winning 77,037 votes in Cumilla-2 with the sheaf of paddy symbol. After the election he was given a civic reception in Homna.
মোঃ সেলিমুজ্জামান মোল্যা গোপালগঞ্জ-১ (মু:
Md. Salimuzzaman Molla is a Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Gopalganj-1 (Muksudpur and part of Kashiani). This is his first term, in the 13th Parliament. In Parliament he serves as a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Education.

Salimuzzaman Molla was born in 1970 in Paschim Majhigati village, Kashiani Upazila, Gopalganj District. His father is Alhajj Moazzem Hossain and his mother Fatema Begum. He is a businessman by profession.

In party politics he serves as assistant organising secretary (Faridpur Division) of the BNP's central executive committee. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for the first time, with 69,462 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. In this election the sheaf of paddy candidates won all three seats in Gopalganj.
মোঃ হারুন-অর-রশিদ রাজবাড়ী-২ (পাংশা, কাল:
Md. Harun-Or-Rashid is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Rajbari-2 (Pangsha, Kalukhali and Baliakandi). This is his first term in Parliament, as the nominee of the BNP (Bangladesh Nationalist Party). In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology.

He was born on 1 July 1970 in Machhpara, Pangsha Thana, Rajbari. His father is the late Motiar Rahman and his mother Monowara Begum. He is a businessman by profession.

Harun-Or-Rashid is a former general secretary of the Rajbari District BNP. For the 13th parliamentary election the BNP gave him the party nomination for Rajbari-2.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Rajbari-2 with 237,254 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোছাঃ তাহসিনা রুশদীর সিলেট-২ আসন থেকে নি:
Mst. Tahsina Rushdir is a Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Sylhet-2. Known as Tahsina Rushdir Luna, this politician is representing the seat in Parliament for the first time, in the 13th Parliament. She is the first woman elected MP from Sylhet Division. In Parliament she is a member of the Committee on Private Members' Bills and Resolutions and the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Education.

Tahsina Rushdir was born on 31 December 1966. Her father is A. B. M. Ekramul Hasan and her mother Mst. Mahfuza Khatun.

She studied at the University of Dhaka and worked as a deputy registrar of the University of Dhaka. In politics she has served as an adviser to the BNP chairman.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, she was elected MP for the first time, with 116,697 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.

She is the wife of BNP leader M. Ilias Ali. The couple have two sons and a daughter.
মোছাঃ সাবিরা সুলতানা ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংস:
Mst. Sabira Sultana is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-14 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament for the first time on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP).

Sabira Sultana was born on 20 October 1976. She is the daughter of Md. Abdul Mannan and Mst. Razia Sultana. She is a businesswoman and social worker by profession. She lives in Kirtipur, in ward 5 of Jhikargacha municipality, Jashore.

Her husband, Md. Nazmul Islam, was a businessman and social worker. After her husband's death in 2011 she became active in politics. In the 2026 election to the 13th Parliament she contested Jashore-2 as the BNP candidate and received 146,447 votes. The BNP later nominated her for a reserved women's seat, and she became the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-14 through the votes of the members of parliament.
মোসাঃ ফরিদা ইয়াসমিন ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংস:
Mst. Farida Yeasmin is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-6 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament for the first time on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). She is a member of the BNP central executive committee. In Parliament she is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Planning.

Farida Yeasmin was born on 5 June 1961. She lives in Bheramara upazila, Kushtia district. She is a social worker by profession. Her name was announced on the BNP's list of 36 for the reserved women's seats in the 13th Parliament as the candidate for the Meherpur and Kushtia region. She became the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-6 through the votes of the members of parliament.
মোসাম্মৎ শাম্মী আক্তার ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় স:
Musammat Shammi Akther is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-22 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament for the second time on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). She is assistant local government affairs secretary of the BNP central executive committee and a member of the party's media cell.

Shammi Akther was born on 2 November 1973 in Chunarughat, Habiganj district. Her father is freedom fighter commander Sirajul Islam. She is a former student of the University of Dhaka. She is a social worker by profession.

She has served as joint secretary and as acting convener of the Habiganj district BNP. In the 9th Parliament, from 2009 to 2014, she was a BNP-nominated member of parliament for women's seat 38, and during that time she was a member of the Library Committee of Parliament.

Her name was on the BNP's announced list of 36 for the reserved women's seats in the 13th Parliament as a former member of parliament. She became the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-22 through the votes of the members of parliament.
মোস্তফা কামাল পাশা ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Mostafa Kamal Pasha is the member of parliament for Chattogram-3 (Sandwip) in the 13th Parliament. This veteran leader of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has previously been a member of parliament for this seat.

Mostafa Kamal Pasha was born on 10 November 1947 in Sandwip upazila, Chattogram district. He is the son of Haji Abdul Baten and Mosammat Sakina Khatun.

He has long experience in local government. From 1973 to 1990 he was elected chairman of Rahmatpur union in Sandwip upazila four times in a row. In 1990 he was elected upazila chairman. In the parliamentary elections of February 1996 and 2001 he was elected member of parliament for Chattogram-3 for the BNP. Within the party he has served as convener of the Sandwip upazila BNP and as a member of the BNP national executive committee.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was again elected member of parliament for Chattogram-3 as the BNP candidate, winning 73,037 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোহাম্মদ আবু সুফিয়ান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সং:
Mohammad Abu Sufian is the member of parliament for Chattogram-9 (14 wards of Chattogram City Corporation) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP).

Abu Sufian was born on 1 October 1964 in Saharbil village, Chakaria upazila, Cox's Bazar district. He is the son of Abul Hashem and Hure Jannat Begum. He is a businessman by profession.

In the early 1980s, while studying at Chittagong College, he joined Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal politics, inspired by the ideals of President Ziaur Rahman. In 1985 he was elected vice-president of the city Chhatra Dal, and in 1987 its president. In 1990 he was the Chattogram convener of the anti-autocracy All-Party Students' Unity Council. In 1996 he became joint secretary of the metropolitan BNP, and he later served as senior vice-president of the metropolitan BNP. He was the BNP candidate for Chattogram-8 in the 2018 national election and in the 2020 by-election.

In the election to the 13th Parliament he stood for Chattogram-9 by decision of the party. Contesting the election with pledges to end waterlogging, improve civic services and ensure law and order, he was elected member of parliament on 12 February 2026, winning 109,388 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
মোহাম্মদ আবুল হাসান সিলেট-৫ (জকিগঞ্জ ও ক:
Mohammed Abul Hasan is the Khelafat Majlis member of parliament elected from Sylhet-5 (Zakiganj and Kanaighat). Known as Mufti Abul Hasan, this Islamic scholar, preacher, mosque khatib and madrasa muhaddith is serving in Parliament for the first time, as a member of the 13th Parliament. In Parliament he is a member of a special committee and of the standing committee on the Ministry of Religious Affairs.

Abul Hasan was born on 15 October 1966 in Majargram, No. 2 Birshri union, Zakiganj upazila, Sylhet district. His father, Abdul Latif, was known locally as Kazi Saheb. His mother is Mosammat Asharun Bibi. He is the eldest of four brothers and three sisters.

His education began at the village maktab. After studying up to class five at West Jamdahar Government Primary School, he completed hifz (memorisation of the Quran) at Jamea Darus Sunnah Barapathar Madrasa. Later, at Dhaka Uttar Ranaping Madrasa, under the Azad Deeni Edara-e-Talim board, he passed the Safela Chaharam examination in 1986, Mutawassitah in 1989, Fazilat in 1991 and Dawra-e-Hadith in 1992. He came first in the last three of these examinations. In 1992–1993 he obtained a higher degree in the department of fatwa and Islamic research at Jamia Islamia Patiya, Chattogram.

In 1993 he joined Jamia Islamia Darussunnah Mohammadia Lamargram Madrasa as mufti and muhaddith. He later became head of its ifta (fatwa) department and Shaikhul Hadith, posts he still holds. In 2000 he was appointed imam and khatib of Zakiganj Central Jame Mosque, and since 2013 he has also served as khatib of the Central Mokam Mosque in Beanibazar municipal town.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament with 79,355 votes as the candidate of Khelafat Majlis, backed by the 11-party electoral alliance led by Jamaat-e-Islami, standing with the wall clock symbol.
মোহাম্মদ এনামুল হক, যিনি এনামুল হক এনাম:
Mohammed Enamul Hoque, known as Enamul Hoque Enam, is the member of parliament for Chattogram-12 (Patiya) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP).

Enamul Hoque was born on 5 March 1969. He is the son of the late Nurul Haque and the late Salma Khatun. He is a businessman by profession.

He has long been involved in the BNP's organisational work in south Chattogram. He has served as senior joint convener of the Chattogram South district BNP and convener of the Patiya upazila BNP. He was also the BNP candidate for the Patiya seat in the election to the 11th Parliament in 2018.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected member of parliament for Chattogram-12 as the BNP candidate, winning 135,044 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. With this victory a BNP candidate won the Patiya seat for the first time since 2001.
মোহাম্মদ কয়ছর আহমেদ সুনামগঞ্জ-৩ (জগন্না:
Mohamed Koysor Ahmed is a Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Sunamganj-3 (Jagannathpur and Shantiganj). This is his first term, in the 13th Parliament. In Parliament he is a member of the House Committee.

Koysor Ahmed was born in 1974. His father is Md. Abdul Matin and his mother Surma Bibi.

This UK-based politician is a former general secretary of the BNP in the United Kingdom. He is currently a member of the BNP's central executive committee.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for the first time, with 97,313 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol. He is one of three expatriate leaders who won in Sylhet Division on BNP nominations.
মোহাম্মদ ফখরুল ইসলাম ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংস:
Mohammed Fakrul Islam is the member of parliament for Noakhali-5 (Companiganj and Kabirhat upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), and took the oath as a member of parliament on 17 February 2026. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Planning.

Fakrul Islam is a native of Noakhali. He is the son of Alhaj Ahmed Ullah and Rezia Begum. By profession he is a businessman. In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament as BNP's nominated candidate for Noakhali-5, winning 147,808 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
রাশেদা বেগম হীরা ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে স:
Rasheda Begum Hira is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-3 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). She is training affairs secretary of the BNP central committee. In Parliament she is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Women and Children Affairs.

Rasheda Begum Hira was born on 29 August 1957. She is the daughter of the late Solaiman Tapadar and the late Anwara Begum. She obtained a master's degree from the University of Chittagong in 1981 and an MPhil from the University of Rajshahi in 1990. She is a social worker by profession.

While at university she joined Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal politics in 1979. In 2009 she became a BNP member of parliament for a reserved women's seat. Former MP Rasheda Hira is one of the 36 people the BNP nominated for the reserved women's seats in the 13th Parliament. Through the votes of the members of parliament she again became a member of parliament, for reserved Women's Seat-3.
রুমিন ফারহানা ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে ব্রা:
Rumeen Farhana is the independent member of parliament for Brahmanbaria-2 (Sarail and Ashuganj upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. A lawyer and politician, she was previously a member of the 11th Parliament from a reserved seat for women. She has now come to Parliament for the second time.

Rumeen Farhana was born on 19 August 1981 in Islampur, Bijoynagar upazila, Brahmanbaria district. Her father, Oli Ahad, was a veteran of the Language Movement, one of the organisers of the Liberation War and a politician honoured with the Independence Award. Her mother is Rashida Begum. She was introduced to politics through her family. After completing her secondary education at Holy Cross Girls' High School and her higher secondary education at Viqarunnisa Noon School and College, she completed a bachelor's degree in law under the University of London. She later qualified as a barrister at Lincoln's Inn in the United Kingdom.

By profession she is an advocate of the High Court Division of the Supreme Court of Bangladesh and a member of the Dhaka Bar Association. Alongside law and politics, she is also known as a writer. Her published books include Amader Rojnamcha ("Our Diary", 2018), Jotota Bolte Perechhi ("As Much as I Could Say", 2022) and Sangsader Dinguli ("Days in Parliament", 2026).

In her political career Rumeen has served as assistant international affairs secretary of BNP's central committee. On 28 May 2019 she was elected unopposed, on a BNP nomination, as member of parliament for Reserved Women's Seat-50, and she was the party's only woman member in the 11th Parliament. On 11 December 2022 she resigned her seat in Parliament.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, she was elected member of parliament for Brahmanbaria-2 as an independent candidate, winning 118,547 votes with the duck symbol. She took the oath as a member of parliament on 17 February 2026.
রেজা কিবরিয়া হবিগঞ্জ-১ আসন থেকে নির্বাচ:
Reza Kibria is the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Habiganj-1. An economist, writer and politician, he is serving in Parliament for the first time, as a member of the 13th Parliament. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Education.

Reza Kibria was born on 6 March 1957 in Jalalsap village in Habiganj subdivision of what was then Sylhet district (now Nabiganj upazila, Habiganj). His father, Shah A. M. S. Kibria, was a former finance minister of Bangladesh. His mother, Asma Kibria, was a painter. His sister, Nazli Kibria, teaches in the Department of Sociology at Boston University in the United States.

He obtained a bachelor's degree in politics, philosophy and economics from the University of Oxford and a master's degree in economics from Queen's University. He later completed an MPhil and a DPhil in economics, also at Oxford. In 1984 he joined the International Monetary Fund (IMF), and he taught in the Department of Economics at the University of Dhaka. From 1996 to 2000 he was macroeconomic adviser to the revenue department of the Government of Papua New Guinea, then chief economist of PDP Australia, and from 2009 to 2011 macroeconomic adviser at the IMF's East Africa Regional Technical Assistance Centre. While teaching at Griffith University, from 2016 he spent two years as the IMF's macro-fiscal adviser at the Ministry of Economy and Finance of the Government of Cambodia. He has been chairman of Integro Holdings since 2015.

His active political career began in 2018, when he returned home and joined Gano Forum. He became a member of Gano Forum's presidium and later its general secretary. On 26 October 2021 he took over as convener of Gono Odhikar Parishad. On 1 December 2025 he formally joined BNP, and the party nominated him for the Habiganj-1 seat.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament for the first time, winning 111,999 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. His wife is Simi Kibria.
রেহানা আক্তার রানু ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে:
Rahana Akter Ranu is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-4 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament for the third time on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). She is assistant training affairs secretary of the BNP central committee.

Rahana Akter Ranu is the daughter of Abdul Mazid and Nurjahan Begum. She is a businesswoman by profession.

As the BNP candidate for reserved women's seats she became a member of parliament in the 8th Parliament in 2001 and in the 9th Parliament in 2009. Her name was on the BNP's announced list of 36 for the reserved women's seats in the 13th Parliament as a former member of parliament. She became the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-4 through the votes of the members of parliament.
লুৎফুর রহমান, যিনি লুৎফুর রহমান কাজল নাম:
Lutfur Rahman, known as Lutfur Rahman Kajal, is the member of parliament for Cox's Bazar-3 (Cox's Bazar Sadar, Eidgaon and Ramu upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. This leader of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has been elected member of parliament for the second time. He is fishermen's affairs secretary of the BNP national executive committee. In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Road Transport and Bridges.

Lutfur Rahman Kajal was born on 18 November 1966 in Gomatali union, Cox's Bazar district. His father, the late Alhaj Mostafizur Rahman, was an industrialist and social worker. His mother, Saleha Khanam, is a teacher and a former member of parliament.

Alongside politics he is an industrial entrepreneur and chairman of Niribili Group.

He entered politics through the Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal in 1980. He later held posts at various levels of the Jubo Dal and the BNP. In 2001 he was first elected member of parliament for Cox's Bazar-3.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was again elected member of parliament for Cox's Bazar-3 as the BNP candidate, winning 182,096 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. His wife is Shirin Rahman, and they have two sons.
শামা ওবায়েদ ইসলাম পররাষ্ট্র প্রতিমন্ত্র:
Shama Obaed Islam is State Minister for Foreign Affairs and MP for Faridpur-2 (Nagarkanda-Saltha). She took office on 17 February 2026. She is one of the seven women who won in that year's election and one of the three women in the cabinet. A computer scientist by training, Shama long worked, as a key member of the BNP's foreign relations committee, on the party's contacts with diplomats in Dhaka.

She was born in Faridpur on 14 May 1973. Her father, K. M. Obaidur Rahman, was an organiser of the independence movement, the BNP's fourth secretary general and a minister more than once; her mother, Shaheda Obaed, is an educationist and a former chairman of the Dhaka Education Board. After her studies at Viqarunnisa Noon School and College she went to the United States, where she took a bachelor's degree in computer science with highest honours from California State University and an MBA from the University of Phoenix. In the United States she worked in finance and technology at First Union Bank.

After her father's death she returned home and joined the BNP. In 2008 and 2018 she was the party's candidate in Faridpur-2, her father's long-held seat. In 2010 she became president of Jatiyatabadi Muktijuddher Projonmo, an organisation of the descendants of freedom fighters. Drawing on her knowledge of computer science, she was at the forefront of building public opinion on the risks of using EVMs (electronic voting machines) in elections.

On 20 November 2025, ahead of the election, she formally renounced her United States citizenship. In the 2026 election she was elected MP for the first time, from Faridpur-2 with 120,909 votes. Her husband, Mostajirul Shovon Islam, is managing director of the garment manufacturer Sparrow Group; they have two children.
শামীম আরা বেগম স্বপ্না ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় স:
Shamim Ara Begum Shapna is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-21 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament for the first time on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). She has long served as general secretary of the Cox's Bazar district BNP.

Shamim Ara Begum Shapna was born on 1 July 1960 in Moddhom Tekpara village, Cox's Bazar municipality. She is the daughter of Abul Khair and Fatema Khatun. After obtaining a master's degree in botany from the University of Chittagong in 1984, she studied law.

In 1986 she entered the legal profession as a member of the Cox's Bazar District Bar Association, and she has worked as a lawyer for more than four decades. In 2001 she was appointed public prosecutor (PP) of the Cox's Bazar district court. According to various media reports, she is the country's first woman public prosecutor.

Her political life began in 1982 through the Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal, while she was studying at the University of Chittagong. She later became general secretary of the Cox's Bazar district Mohila Dal. At the council of the Cox's Bazar district BNP held in the period after One-Eleven, she was elected general secretary. Various news media have reported on her role in the organisational restructuring of the district BNP and in activating the organisation at the grassroots.

On 20 April 2026 the BNP nominated her for a reserved women's seat, and on 23 April the Election Commission declared her nomination paper valid. She became the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-21 through the votes of the members of parliament.
শাহজাহান চৌধুরী ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে কক:
Shahjahan Chowdhury is the member of parliament for Cox's Bazar-4 (Ukhia and Teknaf upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. This veteran leader of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has been elected member of parliament for the fifth time. He is a former Whip of Parliament and an organiser of the Liberation War.

Shahjahan Chowdhury was born on 31 December 1952 in Rajapalong union, Ukhia upazila, Cox's Bazar district. His father, Abul Kashem Chowdhury, was chairman of the undivided Rajapalong union parishad; his mother is Begum Nur Jahan Chowdhury. After completing his primary and secondary education in Ukhia, he passed the intermediate examination from Chittagong College, and in 1975 he completed a BA (Honours) in sociology at the University of Chittagong.

He has been active in politics since his school days. During the Liberation War, as president of the Ukhia thana Chhatra League, he played an active part on the side of the Liberation War. According to accounts in various books, in December 1971 news of a plan to move the weapons out of Ukhia police station reached the freedom fighters through him, and on that basis the Ukhia police station operation was carried out on 12 December.

In 1977 he was elected chairman of the Rajapalong union parishad. A founding joint convener of the BNP in what was then Cox's Bazar subdivision, Shahjahan Chowdhury later served two terms as president of the Cox's Bazar district BNP. In the election to the 2nd Parliament in 1979 he was first elected member of parliament, from what was then Chattogram-18 (Ramu, Ukhia and Teknaf), and in the 2nd Parliament he was a Whip of the ruling party. He was elected member of parliament for Cox's Bazar-4 in 1991, February 1996 and 2001. In the 5th Parliament he was a member of the all-party parliamentary committee formed to establish peace in the Chittagong Hill Tracts and of the committee on the Ministry of Home Affairs. In the 8th Parliament he was chair of the parliamentary standing committee on the Ministry of Housing and Public Works.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was again elected member of parliament for Cox's Bazar-4 as the BNP candidate, winning 123,582 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
শাহজাহান চৌধুরী ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে চট:
Shahjahan Chowdhury is the member of parliament for Chattogram-15 (Lohagara upazila and most of Satkania upazila) in the 13th Parliament. This leader of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami has been elected member of parliament for the third time. He is a member of Jamaat's central executive council and a former ameer of the Chattogram metropolitan unit. In Parliament he is a member of the Committee on Private Members' Bills and Private Members' Resolutions.

Shahjahan Chowdhury was born in Chhamdar Para, Satkania, Chattogram district. He is the son of Obaidur Rahman Chowdhury.

He completed his primary education at Satkania Chhamdar Para Primary School and his secondary education at Satkania Model High School. He then obtained a Diploma in Commerce from Chittagong Government Polytechnic Institute and passed the B.Com from Government City College, Chittagong. He later obtained an LLB degree. He is a businessman by profession.

He was first elected member of parliament in the election to the 5th Parliament in 1991. In the election to the 8th Parliament in 2001 he was elected for the second time, from Chattogram-14.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected member of parliament for Chattogram-15 as the Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami candidate, winning 181,238 votes.
শিরীন সুলতানা ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে সংরক:
Sherin Sultana is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-2 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament for the second time on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). She is self-reliance affairs secretary of the BNP central committee. In Parliament she is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Home Affairs.

Sherin Sultana was born on 3 May 1967. She is the daughter of Abdul Motaleb and Fouzia Akter. She is a businesswoman by profession.

She is a former general secretary of the Mohila Dal. In 2001 she was a BNP member of parliament for a reserved women's seat in the 8th Parliament. Her name was second on the BNP's final list of 36 for the reserved women's seats in the 13th Parliament. She became the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-2 through the votes of the members of parliament.

Her husband, BNP joint secretary general Khairul Kabir Khokon, is the member of parliament for Narsingdi-1. The couple are thus both members of the same Parliament.
শেখ ফরিদ আহম্মেদ ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে চ:
Sk Farid Ahmed is the member of parliament for Chandpur-3 (Chandpur Sadar and Haimchar upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. He has come to Parliament for the first time, from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP).

Farid Ahmed was born on 1 June 1965 in Shahid Rehanbag village, Chandpur Sadar upazila. He is the son of Sheikh Momtaz Uddin and Begum Roushan Akter. He obtained a BA (bachelor's) degree from the University of Dhaka.

In his professional life he is managing director of the Silkways Group. In politics he has long been in the leadership of Chandpur district BNP. In 2010 he became general secretary of the district BNP, in 2014 he was made convener for the district, and in 2023 he was elected president of Chandpur district BNP.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected a member of parliament, winning 165,404 votes in Chandpur-3 with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
সরওয়ার জামাল নিজাম ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদ:
Sarwar Jamal Nizam is the member of parliament for Chattogram-13 (Anwara and Karnaphuli upazilas) in the 13th Parliament. This experienced politician of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has been elected member of parliament for the fourth time.

Sarwar Jamal Nizam was born in Chattogram. He is the son of Alhaj Habibur Rahman and Alhajjani Anwara Nizam. Vice Admiral Sarwar Jahan Nizam of the Bangladesh Navy is his brother.

On the BNP's nomination he was elected member of parliament three times in a row from the then Chattogram-12 seat, in the elections to the 6th Parliament in February 1996, the 7th Parliament in June 1996 and the 8th Parliament in 2001. Within the party he is a member of the BNP executive committee.

In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected member of parliament for Chattogram-13 as the BNP candidate, winning 126,192 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
সরদার মোঃ সাখাওয়াত হোসেন বকুল স্বাস্থ্য:
Sardar Md. Sakhawat Husain Bakul is Minister for Health and Family Welfare and MP for Narsingdi-4 (Monohardi-Belabo). He was sworn in as minister on 17 February 2026. A freedom fighter of 1971, Bakul has been elected MP from this seat four times.

He was born in 1951 into the Sardar family of Hafizpur village, Chalakchar Union, Monohardi Upazila, Narsingdi; his father is Sardar Asmat Ali. He studied at Chalakchar High School, Narsingdi Government College and the University of Dhaka, and was GS (general secretary) of the Narsingdi Government College students' union. While a student at the University of Dhaka he took an active part in the Liberation War.

He began his political career in the Chhatra Union and later joined the BNP. He has served as senior vice-president of the Narsingdi District BNP, convener of the Monohardi Upazila BNP and president of the upazila Muktijoddha Sangsad (freedom fighters' council).

He won Narsingdi-4 in the elections of 1991, February 1996 and 2001; in one of these his opponent was the Awami League candidate, former army chief Lieutenant General (retd) Nuruddin Khan. In the 2026 election he was elected MP for the fourth time with 161,912 votes.
সরোয়ার আলমগীর ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে চট্:
Sarowar Alamgir is the member of parliament for Chattogram-2 (Fatikchhari) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change.

Alongside politics, Sarowar Alamgir is a businessman. He is the founder and chief executive officer of Halda Group, a Chattogram-based industrial group. Founded in the mid-1990s, the group works in ready-made garments, garment accessories, textile manufacturing and real estate.

As a member of the BNP he has taken part in various political activities of the party in Chattogram. In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he won the Chattogram-2 seat as the BNP candidate, receiving 138,545 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol. After the gazette of the results was published, he took the oath as a member of parliament on 9 July 2026.
সাইদ উদ্দিন আহমাদ হানজালা মাদারীপুর-১ (শ:
Sayed Uddin Ahmad Hanzala is a Bangladesh Khelafat Majlis member of parliament elected from Madaripur-1 (Shibchar). This Islamic scholar, known as Pirzada Hanzala, is representing the seat in Parliament for the first time, in the 13th Parliament. In Parliament he is a member of the Standing Committee on the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology.

Hanzala was born on 24 March 1997 in Bahadurpur village, Shibchar Upazila, Madaripur District. His father is Mubin Uddin Ahmad and his mother Ruhana Ahmed. He is a seventh-generation descendant of Haji Shariatullah.

After memorising the Quran (hifz) at a local madrasa, he studied under the Madani Nisab curriculum in Dhaka. He later completed the Dawra-e-Hadith at Madrasatul Arabia Al Islamia Darul Uloom in Azaadville, Africa. He is an Islamic scholar by profession.

Hanzala is a member of the central executive committee of Bangladesh Khelafat Majlis. In the 13th parliamentary election of 2026, standing as the candidate of the 11-party electoral alliance under the rickshaw symbol, he won with a total of 64,909 votes, by a margin of 385 votes.
সাঈদ আল নোমান ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে চট্ট:
Sayeed Al Noman is the member of parliament for Chattogram-10 (the Double Mooring, Pahartali and Khulshi areas) in the 13th Parliament. He has entered Parliament for the first time, for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament he is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and of the Library Committee, and chair of Sub-committee No. 5 of the Library Committee. In June 2026 the Speaker nominated him a member of the Senate of the University of Chittagong.

Sayeed Al Noman was born on 22 December 1979. His father is Abdullah Al Noman, a former vice-chairman of the BNP and former minister, who was a member of parliament from the same area. His mother is Tasmin Ara Begum.

He obtained a bachelor's degree from Central Michigan University in the United States, a master's degree from the London School of Economics and Political Science and an MPhil from St Cross College, University of Oxford. In 2006, together with his father, he founded East Delta University in Chattogram, and he is vice-chairman of the university's board of trustees.

He became more active in politics after the July uprising of 2024. During the election campaign he went to voters in markets, at tea stalls and from neighbourhood to neighbourhood, pledging to build Chattogram into a hub of skilled young people, to create jobs and to provide modern civic services. In the election to the 13th Parliament held on 12 February 2026 he was elected member of parliament for Chattogram-10, winning 122,978 votes with the sheaf of paddy symbol.
সাঈদ আহমেদ শরীয়তপুর-১ আসন থেকে নির্বাচি:
Sayeed Ahmed is a Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) member of parliament elected from Shariatpur-1. Known as Sayeed Ahmed Aslam, this businessman and politician is representing the seat in Parliament for the first time, in the 13th Parliament.

He was born on 3 January 1962 in Damudya Upazila, Shariatpur District. His father is Md. Ali Akbar Mia and his mother Syeda Safia Akbar.

In his professional life he is an established businessman. He is the proprietor of Ahmed Shipping Lines, Ahmed Inland Shipping Agency, A K International and Ahmed Airways Services. He also serves as chairman of Global Insurance Limited.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP as the BNP candidate with 77,398 votes under the sheaf of paddy symbol.
সাচিং প্রু জেরী পার্বত্য চট্টগ্রাম বিষয়:
Saching Prue Jerry is the Minister for Chittagong Hill Tracts Affairs and the member of parliament for the hill district seat of Bandarban. He has been in charge of this ministry since August 2026. A member of the royal family of the Bohmong Circle, Jerry belongs to the Marma Buddhist community; he is convener of the Bandarban district BNP and a member of the party's national executive committee.

His father, Aung Shwe Prue Chowdhury, was the Bohmong Raja. His maternal uncle's wife, Ma Mya Ching, was a member of the 5th and 6th Parliaments from a reserved women's seat.

He was first elected member of parliament for the Bandarban hill district seat in the election to the 6th Parliament in 1996. He has also served as chairman of the Bandarban Sadar upazila parishad and of the Bandarban Hill District Council. Winning by a wide margin in the 2026 election to the 13th Parliament, he entered Parliament for the second time and was given charge of the ministry for the affairs of the three hill districts.
সানজিদা ইসলাম ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদে সংরক:
Sanjida Islam is the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-16 in the 13th Parliament. She has entered Parliament for the first time on the nomination of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). In Parliament she is a member of the standing committee on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

Known as Sanjida Islam Tuli, she was born on 8 March 1983. She passed her secondary and higher secondary examinations from BAF Shaheen College Dhaka. She then obtained a bachelor's degree in textile engineering from Bangladesh University of Textiles.

Sanjida Islam is a human rights activist and a coordinator of Mayer Daak. In 2025 she was nominated for the international Human Rights Tulip award for her human rights work.

In the 2026 election to the 13th Parliament she contested Dhaka-14. The BNP later nominated her for a reserved women's seat, and she became the member of parliament for reserved Women's Seat-16 through the votes of the members of parliament.
সালাহ উদ্দিন, যিনি সালাহউদ্দিন আইউবী নাম:
Salah Uddin, known as Salahuddin Ayubi, is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Gazipur-4 (Kapasia). This is his first term in Parliament, as the nominee of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. He is a member of Jamaat's central Majlis-e-Shura and deputy ameer (naib-e-ameer) of its Gazipur Metropolitan unit.

He was born on 2 March 1987 in Belashi village, Rayed Union, Gazipur District. His father is Maulana Imam Uddin and his mother Asma Akter.

He has received higher education in both the general and the madrasa streams. He completed his Dakhil at Rayed Darus Sunnah Dakhil Madrasa, his Alim and Fazil at Mohakhali Darul Ulum Hossainia Kamil Madrasa, and his Kamil at Dhaka Alia Madrasa. He also obtained a bachelor's (Hons) degree in English language and literature from Dhaka College, a master's degree from World University of Bangladesh and an LLB degree from the National University. He is a teacher by profession.

In 2021 he served as central president of Bangladesh Islami Chhatra Shibir.

In the 13th parliamentary election held on 12 February 2026, he was elected MP for Gazipur-4 with 101,779 votes under the scales symbol.
সালাহউদ্দিন আহমদ স্বরাষ্ট্রমন্ত্রী এবং ক:
Salahuddin Ahmed is the Minister for Home Affairs and the member of parliament for Cox's Bazar-1 (Chakaria–Pekua). He took office as minister on 17 February 2026. A lawyer and former government official, he is a member of the BNP's national standing committee and has also served as the party's spokesperson.

He was born on 30 June 1962 in Sikderpara village, Pekua, Cox's Bazar; his father is Moulvi Saidul Haque and his mother Begum Ayesha Haque. He passed the SSC from Shilkhali High School in Pekua in 1977 and the HSC from Chittagong Government College in 1979. After obtaining a bachelor's (honours) degree in law from the University of Dhaka in 1984 and a master's degree in 1986, he was enrolled as a lawyer. As a student he was a central vice-president of the Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal and for a time its acting president.

Having passed the 7th BCS examination, he joined the administration cadre in 1988, and in 1991 he became assistant private secretary to Prime Minister Khaleda Zia. In January 1996 he left government service to enter active politics, and he won the Cox's Bazar-1 seat three times in a row, in both elections of that year and in 2001. On 10 October 2001 he became State Minister for Communications; he was the first minister from Cox's Bazar district since independence. Pekua was formed as a separate upazila in 2002 on his initiative. He was president of the Cox's Bazar district BNP, and in 2010 he was elected a central joint secretary general of the party.

From February 2007 he was imprisoned for about two years and two months under the caretaker government; during that time his wife, Advocate Hasina Ahmed, won the Cox's Bazar-1 seat in the 2008 election. In March 2015, while he was the party's spokesperson, he went missing from Uttara in Dhaka; about two months later, on 11 May, he was found in Shillong, in Meghalaya, India.
